About the job
At Bluebeam, we empower people to advance the way the world is built. We create smart software solutions that make construction sites more efficient, connected, and safe, and improve the lives of design and construction professionals everywhere.

The DevOps Engineer builds, automates and scales the cloud infrastructure that runs the SiteDocs platform. The position exists to make delivery of software to production reliable, repeatable and secure, and to keep the platform available to customers. The position also provides engineering-led operational coverage for the APAC region — monitoring platform health, responding to production incidents and supporting Australian data centre infrastructure during local business hours. The role partners with software engineering teams in North America and elsewhere to design systems for scale and resilience, streamline deployment pipelines, and remove manual operational work through automation.

What You'll Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the following essential functions:

  • Designs, implements, and maintains CI/CD pipelines and release automation using GitHub and Azure DevOps.
  • Builds and manages cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, provisioning and maintaining environments through infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Monitors system performance, availability, capacity, and security, and acts on alerts before they affect customers.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves production issues, performs root cause analysis, and implements
    changes that improve platform reliability.
  • Provides operational and on-call coverage for the platform in the APAC time zone, including participation in the follow-the-sun incident response rotation.
  • Automates manual and repetitive infrastructure and deployment tasks to reduce operational risk and release friction.
  • Collaborates with software engineering, QA, and security colleagues across time zones to design systems that scale and operate securely.
  • Documents infrastructure, runbooks, and operational procedures so operational knowledge is shared across regions.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar engineering role
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services
  • Infrastructure as code, with Terraform preferred
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and automation processes (GitHub, Azure DevOps)
  • Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows
  • Good understanding of system and solution architecture, including how to design for scale and resilience
  • Ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise production systems
    Soft skills
  • Works independently and owns tasks from start to finish
  • Proactive mindset — anticipates problems and takes initiative rather than waiting for direction
  • Collaborative team spirit, effective within a distributed, cross-time-zone team · Problem-solving attitude in support of the product and colleagues
  • Clear verbal and written communication with technical and non-technical audiences
    Required Years of Experience
  • Total years in field/career: 5+ years in software engineering, IT infrastructure or cloud operations
  • Minimum years in specific function: 3+ years in a dedicated DevOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure role, including hands-on Microsoft Azure and infrastructure as code
  • Specific Education or Certifications Required(i.e. Bachelor’s Degree, MBA, PMP, CPA, etc.)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    Nice to Have
  • Preferred education or experience, but not required
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Network implementation and architecture (VNets, gateways, security)
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot)
  • Knowledge of SQL databases
  • Microsoft Azure certification (e.g. AZ-104, AZ-400)
  • Experience supporting a multi-region SaaS platform and its data centre infrastructure
  • Supervisory Responsibility

This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer with 7+ years of experience who thrives in complex technical environments, possesses strong leadership skills, and is passionate about building production-grade systems using modern C#.NET and React/TypeScript stacks.

This is a full-time position and 100% remote. Must be comfortable working East Coast hours.

  • Lead the development and maintenance of robust, scalable backend services using C# and .NET
  • Architect and build complex, responsive front-end features using React and TypeScript.
  • Guide design discussions, conduct rigorous code reviews, and provide architectural leadership for development squads.

  • Oversee CI/CD pipeline integration, cloud infrastructure deployments, and automation efforts.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous growth.
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Expert proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (Core/6+).
  • Strong hands-on experience building complex front-end applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Proven experience architecting RESTful APIs, microservices, and managing interactions with relational (SQL Server) and non-relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, design patterns, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e), and version control (Git).
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and drive successful project delivery.
This role is based in the US and only open to citizens and permanent residents of the US who do not require visa sponsorship.

raw.description:
Job Title: Healthcare Staffing & Outreach Specialist

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Daylight Time, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch break

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based home healthcare and staffing provider serving pediatric and adult patients. The organization provides medical and non-medical home care services, including staffing support for Medicaid waiver patients and private duty nursing cases.

We are seeking a confident, proactive, and results-driven Healthcare Staffing & Outreach Specialist to support facility outreach, business development, recruitment initiatives, and administrative coordination.

A major focus of this role will be outbound calling and relationship-building with healthcare facilities, hospitals, clinics, caseworkers, and other referral sources. You will introduce the organization's services, identify staffing and patient care opportunities, and help connect available healthcare professionals with facilities and patients who need support.

You will also assist with recruitment efforts for Medicaid waiver programs and private duty nursing cases, particularly for pediatric patients ages 0–21. Depending on your experience, you may also support insurance credentialing and other administrative workflows.

The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, persistent with follow-ups, comfortable initiating conversations, and motivated by measurable results. Candidates with healthcare credentialing experience who are also comfortable with outreach and cold calling are especially encouraged to apply.

Training will be provided on the client's workflows and systems, including HHAeXchange and the selected phone/communication platform.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Healthcare Outreach & Business Development

  • Conduct outbound calls to healthcare facilities, hospitals, clinics, caseworkers, and other potential referral or business partners
  • Introduce the organization's home healthcare and staffing services
  • Explain available staffing and private duty nursing services clearly and professionally
  • Identify facility staffing needs and potential patient care opportunities
  • Communicate with hospital and clinic caseworkers regarding private duty nursing services for pediatric patients ages 0–21
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare contacts and referral sources
  • Conduct consistent follow-ups with prospective facilities and contacts
  • Help position available healthcare staffing services as a solution to identified needs
  • Coordinate appointments or follow-up conversations when appropriate
  • Track outreach activity, responses, opportunities, and next steps

Recruitment & Staffing Support

  • Support recruitment-focused outreach for Medicaid waiver patients and private duty nursing opportunities
  • Contact relevant healthcare facilities and caseworkers to identify potential patient placements
  • Assist with matching available staff to appropriate patient care or staffing opportunities
  • Maintain organized records of staffing needs, opportunities, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate with the internal team regarding new staffing or patient opportunities
  • Support recruitment and placement initiatives as needed

Credentialing & Administrative Support

  • Assist with healthcare credentialing when within the candidate's experience
  • Contact insurance companies regarding credentialing requirements and status
  • Assist with completing credentialing processes for insurance plans the organization is not yet credentialed with
  • Follow up on outstanding credentialing information and requirements
  • Maintain accurate records of credentialing progress
  • Provide general administrative and coordination support
  • Maintain organized documentation and activity records
  • Prepare and submit end-of-day updates and reports as required

Top 3 Priorities

1. Healthcare Facility Outreach

Conduct consistent outbound outreach to facilities, hospitals, clinics, caseworkers, and other referral sources to identify new staffing and patient care opportunities.

2. Recruitment & Staffing Support

Support recruitment efforts for Medicaid waiver patients and private duty nursing cases by identifying opportunitiesand helping connect available staff with patient and facility needs.

3. Credentialing Support

Assist with insurance credentialing and follow-up when needed. Credentialing experience is highly beneficial but may not be required for candidates with strong outreach and business development experience.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured through consistent productivity and measurable outreach results, including:

  • Outbound outreach activity and follow-up
  • New healthcare facility and referral opportunities identified
  • Recruitment and staffing opportunities generated
  • Accuracy and consistency of activity tracking and end-of-day reports
  • Follow-through on outreach and credentialing tasks
  • Contribution toward a target of approximately 4 new clients per month

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in cold calling, outbound outreach, business development, recruitment, appointment setting, or a similar role
  • Strong professional phone communication skills
  • Confident initiating conversations with new healthcare and business contacts
  • Comfortable conducting a high volume of outbound outreach
  • Strong follow-up skills and persistence
  • Ability to explain services clearly and professionally
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Recruitment or staffing experience
  • Ability to identify opportunities and move conversations toward appropriate next steps
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Able to maintain accurate outreach records and activity reports
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Results-oriented and comfortable working toward productivity targets
  • Reliable, responsive, and consistent

Highly Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare credentialing experience
  • Healthcare business development or outreach experience
  • Home healthcare or healthcare staffing experience
  • Experience with Medicaid waiver programs
  • Private duty nursing staffing or recruitment experience
  • Experience communicating with hospital or clinic caseworkers
  • Healthcare recruitment or staffing experience
  • Experience contacting insurance companies regarding credentialing
  • Appointment-setting experience
  • Experience using HHAeXchange
  • Experience with CRM or call-tracking platforms such as GoHighLevel
  • Familiarity with VoIP or cloud-based phone systems

Candidates may be considered if they have:

  • Strong business development/outreach experience without credentialing experience
  • Strong business development experience with some credentialing familiarity
  • Healthcare credentialing experience combined with a willingness and confidence to perform cold calling and outreach

Candidates with credentialing experience and a strong outbound communication style are particularly encouraged to apply.

Training will be provided on HHAeXchange and the client's selected phone system. Healthcare industry knowledge may also be developed through training for candidates with strong transferable outreach skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Confident and engaging on outbound calls
  • Comfortable initiating conversations with new contacts
  • Persistent without being unprofessional or overly aggressive
  • Results-driven and motivated by measurable goals
  • Strong at building professional relationships
  • Organized and consistent with follow-ups
  • Comfortable balancing outreach, recruitment, credentialing, and administrative tasks
  • Proactive and able to work independently
  • Adaptable and willing to learn healthcare-specific workflows
  • Reliable and accountable for achieving expected productivity

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Job Description

The Adaptive Physical Education (APE) Teacher – CONTRACTOR is responsible for providing virtual adaptive physical education services to eligible special education students enrolled in virtual public schools within the STAGES/Stride network. Services are provided in accordance with students' Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) and may include evaluations, direct services, consultation, records reviews, and participation in special education processes.

The APE Teacher collaborates with students, families, educators, therapists, and multidisciplinary teams to promote access to physical education, motor skill development, physical fitness, and participation in age-appropriate physical activities within home and community environments.

This is an Independent Contractor position (1099).
Residency Requirements: Must reside in the U.S.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Conduct adaptive physical education evaluations and reevaluations.
    • Review educational records, assessment data, medical information, therapy reports, and other documentation.
    • Prepare evaluation reports and present findings to IEP teams.
    • Provide virtual direct adaptive physical education services per IEP requirements.
    • Develop individualized goals and objectives.
    • Consult with families, teachers, therapists, and service providers.
    • Recommend modifications, accommodations, and adaptive strategies.
    • Participate in eligibility, evaluation, annual review, and reevaluation meetings.
    • Maintain service logs, progress monitoring data, and reports.
    • Monitor and report progress toward IEP goals.
    • Maintain compliance with federal, state, and school regulations.
    • Utilize virtual platforms and technology tools to deliver services.
    • Maintain a professional work environment and dependable schedule.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience providing Adaptive Physical Education services to students with disabilities in educational settings.
    • Experience conducting evaluations, records reviews, and developing individualized recommendations.
    • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and participating in the IEP process.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Valid teaching certificate in accordance with state requirements.
    • Louisiana Department of Education (LDOE) Adapted Physical Education Endorsement required.
    • Ability to maintain all required credentials and endorsements throughout the duration of the contract.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience providing services within virtual, online, or remote educational environments.
    • Experience conducting virtual evaluations, consultations, and direct services.
    • Knowledge of special education laws, regulations, and best practices.
    • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and virtual meeting platforms.

• Ability to pass background checks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is primarily remote and requires the ability to provide services from a professional home office environment. Virtual service delivery may include evaluations, consultations, direct services, records reviews, team meetings, and documentation activities.

OTHER DUTIES

This description is not all-inclusive. Additional duties may be assigned. Contract work is at-will per state regulations.

raw.excerpt: About the Company: ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors.
raw.description:
About the Company:

ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors. Our intuitive platform empowers users to create professional drawings on any device—without the steep learning curve of traditional CAD software—helping businesses save time, generate quotes faster, and close deals more efficiently.

We’re a remote-first team with a strong sense of community, driven by growth, collaboration, and our core values: start with the customer, constantly improve, take risks, operate with transparency, and own it. At ArcSite, every team member has the opportunity to grow their career while making an impact, shaping the future of design, and living these values in everything we do.

About the Role:

ArcSite’s product-led growth motion drives roughly half of company revenue and is our largest source of qualified leads. As User Acquisition Manager, PLG, you’ll own user acquisition for our self-serve funnel, with a focus on bringing the right users into the ArcSite product efficiently and at scale.

You’ll lead acquisition strategy across paid channels and App Store Optimization (ASO), managing the channel mix, budget, experimentation, and performance needed to grow self-serve signups and installs. You’ll work closely with Product and Marketing to understand which users and acquisition sources drive the strongest downstream outcomes, using those insights to continuously improve targeting, spend, and channel strategy.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the unique dynamics of self-serve and product-led acquisition and knows how to turn paid and organic channels into a scalable growth engine.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own user acquisition strategy: Develop and execute the acquisition strategy for ArcSite’s PLG motion, identifying opportunities across paid and organic channels to increase qualified self-serve signups and installs.
  • Manage paid acquisition: Own and optimize paid search, social, display, affiliate, and other relevant acquisition channels, with a focus on self-serve users rather than sales-assisted lead generation.
  • Lead ASO strategy: Own App Store Optimization across iOS, Android, and Windows, including keyword strategy, listing optimization, creative testing, ratings and reviews, and regional/international optimization.
  • Manage acquisition budget and channel mix: Allocate and optimize spend across acquisition channels to balance growth, volume, and CAC efficiency.
  • Build and optimize acquisition experiments: Develop a structured testing roadmap across channels, audiences, creative, landing pages, bidding strategies, and store listings to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Measure acquisition quality: Analyze acquisition sources and downstream product behavior to understand which channels, audiences, and campaigns produce the highest-quality users. Use these insights to improve targeting, channel mix, and investment decisions.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Analytics to share acquisition insights, align on growth opportunities, and ensure acquisition strategy supports the broader PLG funnel. Product owns activation and conversion; this role owns getting the right users into the funnel.
  • Own acquisition reporting: Establish and monitor key acquisition metrics including CPI, CPA, CAC, signup volume, channel efficiency, store listing conversion, ASO visibility and rankings, and acquisition-source quality.
  • Stay ahead of acquisition trends: Continuously evaluate emerging channels, platform changes, competitive activity, and new acquisition opportunities relevant to PLG and self-serve SaaS.

Requirements

  • 4–6+ years in user acquisition, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or mobile apps with a self-serve/product-led motion
  • Hands-on experience managing paid acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, and/or affiliate channels
  • Hands-on ASO experience across app store platforms (iOS, Android, and/or Windows), including keyword optimization and regional/international strategy
  • Familiarity with paid bidding platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and ASO/monitoring tools (e.g., Sensor Tower, AppTweak, Storemaven)
  • Working knowledge of product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) to evaluate the downstream quality of acquired users
  • Comfort with SQL and CAC/funnel-efficiency analysis

Nice to Have

  • Experience acquiring users across multiple platforms, including iOS, Android, Windows, and Web.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, vertical SaaS, mobile applications, or field-service/construction technology.
  • Experience working within a PLG organization where product usage and self-serve conversion are central to the growth model.
  • Experience with ArcSite’s marketing and analytics stack, including HubSpot, GA4, ChartMogul, Ahrefs, ASOlytics, and Mixpanel.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K match
  • $75 monthly wellness stipend

ArcSite is an equal opportunity employer and fosters an inclusive environment. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, ethnicity, orientation, creed, or other traits. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives to apply to our positions.

raw.title: Technical Editor
raw.excerpt: Reporting to - Head of Publishing Operations About Packt Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals.
raw.description:
Reporting to - Head of Publishing Operations

About Packt

Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e-books, audiobooks, and video courses.

For more details, visit .

Role Overview

As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into. 

The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.  

The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.

This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.

What You Will Do

Technical:

  • Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
  • Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
  • Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
  • Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
  • Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
  • Perform quality checks on code-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
  • Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
  • Support the team to improve code repositories and code-testing systems
  • Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
  • Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
  • Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles 

Editorial:

  • Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
  • Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
  • Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
  • Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
  • Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
  • Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
  • Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
  • Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet

Author/Expert management: 

  • Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
  • Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators

Who You Are

You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.

Must-have skills:

  • Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
  • Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
  • Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
  • Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
  • Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
  • Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders

Good-to-have skills:

  • Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality-control processes and workflows
  • Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments

Why Work at Packt

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:

  • Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
  • Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
  • Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge-sharing.
  • Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.

We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by: 

  • Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives. 
  • Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility. 
  • Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer-to-peer recognition. 
  • Fostering a culture of self-development. 
  • Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged. 

Benefits
You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.

Bonus scheme 

5 day working week

25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)

Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India

Training programs and Certification

Group Medical Insurance

Wellness initiatives

Salary Range - INR 25K - 40K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)

Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Clinical Site Support Specialist (Sponsor-Dedicated)

Remote - United States

Are you passionate about helping users navigate technology while delivering an exceptional customer experience? Do you enjoy solving problems, guiding stakeholders through new systems, and serving as a trusted resource during change management initiatives?

We are seeking a Clinical Site Support Specialist to join a Sponsor-Dedicated team supporting clinical trial sites as they transition to a unified credentialing and authentication platform. In this highly visible role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for site personnel, providing personalized, white-glove support to ensure seamless access to critical clinical trial technologies.

This is an exciting opportunity for a customer-focused professional who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with exceptional communication and relationship-building abilities. You will play a key role in helping research sites successfully adopt new authentication processes while minimizing disruptions to ongoing clinical trial activities.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Clinical Site Support Specialist, you will provide front-line support to clinical trial sites navigating enrollment, access, and authentication processes across multiple clinical technology platforms. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping site personnel resolve issues quickly while delivering a high-touch support experience.

Site Support & Customer Experience

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clinical trial sites requiring assistance with credentialing, authentication, and platform access.

  • Deliver a concierge-style, white-glove support experience focused on site success and user satisfaction.

  • Respond to site inquiries and support requests within established service-level expectations.

  • Build strong relationships with site personnel, sponsor teams, and program stakeholders.

  • Provide clear, professional, and easy-to-understand guidance to users with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Support continuity of clinical trial operations by rapidly addressing site access challenges.

MFA Enrollment & Authentication Support

  • Develop expertise in the unified credentialing and authentication platform and its integration across multiple clinical systems.

  • Guide users through Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment and setup processes.

  • Troubleshoot login, authentication, and identity verification issues.

  • Support commonly used authentication solutions, including:

    • Auth0

    • ID.me

    • Microsoft Authentication Tools

    • Google Authentication Tools

  • Assist users with authenticator applications, passkeys, and other access verification methods.

  • Ensure users successfully complete enrollment and maintain uninterrupted system access.

Live Training & Virtual Support

  • Conduct scheduled and on-demand virtual support sessions.

  • Walk users through step-by-step enrollment and authentication processes.

  • Provide real-time assistance with platform navigation and access issues.

  • Help users leverage available self-service resources and training materials.

  • Promote user confidence and adoption of new technologies through personalized support.

Technical Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and troubleshoot access-related issues and system challenges.

  • Identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution pathways.

  • Escalate complex technical issues to specialized technical teams when necessary.

  • Partner with Product Owners, technical leads, and stakeholders to resolve issues outside standard support scope.

  • Track open issues and follow through to resolution.

  • Communicate status updates and next steps to users in a timely manner.

Monitoring, Documentation & Reporting

  • Monitor site enrollment progress and completion metrics.

  • Track training participation, platform adoption, and support activities using program tools and dashboards.

  • Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and follow-up activities.

  • Document recurring issues, trends, and best practices.

  • Provide feedback that supports improvements to:

    • FAQs

    • User guides

    • Training materials

    • Self-service resources

    • Support workflows

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

oPartner closely with sponsor teams and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent support experience.

oShare knowledge and lessons learned across support teams.

oContribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency and user satisfaction.

oServe as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for unified credentialing support processes.

oMaintain awareness of clinical technology standards, operating procedures, and business processes.

oSupport ongoing initiatives designed to improve site engagement and technology adoption.

WHO YOU ARE

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience preferred.

  • Experience in:

    • Customer service

    • Technical support

    • Help desk operations

    • User support environments

    • Healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or other regulated industries

  • Working knowledge of:

    • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

    • Identity verification processes

    • Authenticator applications

    • Passkeys and credential management

    • User access troubleshooting

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-touch customer service while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Experience tracking activities, deadlines, and completion metrics.

  • Comfort facilitating live virtual support sessions and user training.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with:

    • Microsoft Office Suite

    • Web-based support tools

    • Online collaboration platforms

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting clinical trial sites or clinical research technologies.

  • Familiarity with:

    • CTMS platforms

    • eCOA systems

    • eConsent solutions

    • IRT/IWRS platforms

    • Clinical trial technology ecosystems

  • Experience supporting:

    • System migrations

    • Platform implementations

    • User adoption initiatives

    • SSO transitions

    • MFA rollouts

  • Experience working with identity management platforms such as:

    • Auth0

    • ID.me

    • Microsoft

    • Google

  • Previous experience supporting sponsor-dedicated programs within a CRO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare environment.

  • Understanding of clinical research site workflows and operational challenges.

WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL

  • Passion for helping users succeed and delivering exceptional customer service.

  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence troubleshooting access and authentication issues.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Calm, professional, and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

  • Self-motivated and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Skilled at balancing technical troubleshooting with empathy and professionalism.

  • Commitment to creating a seamless and positive experience for clinical trial sites.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE THIS OPPORTUNITY

  • Make a direct impact on clinical trial sites and study teams around the world.

  • Serve as a key contributor in a high-visibility sponsor-dedicated program.

  • Combine customer service, technology support, and clinical research operations in one role.

  • Work closely with sponsor stakeholders, product teams, and technical experts.

  • Enjoy a fully remote U.S.-based position with strong team collaboration.

  • Gain exposure to cutting-edge clinical technology platforms and authentication solutions.

  • Join a team committed to delivering exceptional service and continuous improvement.

  • Play a critical role in enabling uninterrupted access to systems that support clinical research and patient outcomes.

If you are a customer-focused support professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, guiding users through new technologies, and creating exceptional experiences, we encourage you to apply and become a trusted partner to clinical research sites across the country.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Responsibilities:

As a Master Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the two-tier optimization engine: (1) heuristic algorithms for market prioritization and budget allocation across multiple markets, and (2) Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) optimization to maximize audience impressions delivery within each market, respecting inventory, pricing, and business constraints. You will work in close collaboration with the client's domain experts throughout the development process, in an agile environment with 2-week sprints.

Requirements for this challenge:

Fluent English (conversation and technical documentation)
Solid experience in Data Science, Operations Research, or Optimization Engineering
Expertise in Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) and optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, or similar)
Solid experience with AWS
Advanced Python
Heuristic algorithm design for large-scale combinatorial problems
Proven experience delivering optimization solutions to production
Multi-objective optimization (balancing multiple metrics and constraints)
Translating business requirements into mathematical formulations
Collaborative work with non-technical stakeholders to co-develop solutions
Agile methodologies (Scrum, 2-week sprints)
Nice to Have:
AWS Lambda for optimization workload deployment
Experience in advertising/media planning or marketing optimization
Knowledge of media metrics (CPM, GRP, impressions, reach, frequency)
Parallel computing for scalable optimization

raw.excerpt: was wir suchen Die #1 Plattform für NeukundenJedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir.
raw.description:
was wir suchen

Die #1 Plattform für Neukunden

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen wir die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Head of IT (m/w/d) für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

das sind deine aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Tech-Team (aktuell 8 Personen aus Entwicklung, Daten und Infrastruktur) disziplinarisch und fachlich – inklusive 1:1s, Zielvereinbarungen, Weiterentwicklung und Recruiting neuer Teammitglieder.

  • Du übernimmst das operative Tagesgeschäft des CTO: Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung, Eskalationen und alle Entscheidungen, die heute noch an ihm hängen bleiben.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung unserer Roadmap über alle vier Bereiche hinweg – Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur – und sorgst dafür, dass zugesagte Termine gehalten werden.

  • Du sorgst für planbare Lieferfähigkeit: Du etablierst klare Prozesse für Planung, Entwicklung, Testing und Release und machst den Fortschritt für alle Bereiche im Unternehmen sichtbar.

  • Du baust eine belastbare Datenbasis auf: Du bringst unsere Kennzahlen zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen in eine Form, der Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung vertrauen können.

  • Du verantwortest Stabilität, Security und Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform – von Monitoring und Incident-Management über Backups und Zugriffsrechte bis zu DSGVO-Themen.

  • Du bleibst technisch nah dran: Du bewertest Architekturentscheidungen, liest Code-Reviews mit und kannst im Zweifel selbst in den Code schauen – auch wenn du nicht mehr die Mehrheit deiner Zeit dort verbringst.

  • Du steuerst technische Schulden aktiv: Du machst sie sichtbar, bewertest sie wirtschaftlich und verhandelst mit den Fachbereichen, wann wir sie abbauen.

  • Du bist der Ansprechpartner der Fachbereiche für alle technischen Themen und übersetzt zwischen Business-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung.

  • Du steuerst externe Dienstleister und Tools, inklusive Auswahl, Verträgen und Budgetverantwortung für den IT-Bereich.

dank deiner expertise erreichst du folgende meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:

    • Du kennst Team, Systemlandschaft, Roadmap und die wichtigsten Stakeholder und hast mit jedem Teammitglied ein 1:1 geführt

    • Du hast eine schriftliche Bestandsaufnahme erstellt: größte Risiken in Stabilität und Security, größte Engpässe in der Lieferfähigkeit, Zustand unserer Datenbasis

    • Du hast die 1:1s, die operative Priorisierung und die täglichen Eskalationen vollständig vom CTO übernommen

    • Gemeinsam mit dem CTO ist schriftlich festgehalten, welche Entscheidungen bei dir liegen und welche bei ihm

  • 4-6 Monate:

    • Fachbereiche wissen jederzeit, woran gearbeitet wird

    • Monitoring, Alerting und ein Incident-Prozess inklusive Post-Mortems sind etabliert; kritische Security- und DSGVO-Lücken aus der Bestandsaufnahme sind geschlossen

    • Eine erste verlässliche Version unseres Kennzahlen-Reportings zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen ist live – mit klar definierten Metriken und benannten Ownern

    • Der CTO wird nur noch bei strategischen Fragen eingebunden, nicht mehr im Tagesgeschäft


  • 7-12 Monate:

    • Die Lieferfähigkeit ist messbar besser als bei deinem Start (z. B. kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, höhere Release-Frequenz, weniger Fehler in Produktion)

    • Ein Plan zum Abbau technischer Schulden läuft und ist mit den Fachbereichen abgestimmt

    • Das Team ist entsprechend der Wachstumsplanung aufgestockt und strukturiert; du hast selbst eingestellt und Verantwortung im Team weiterverteilt

    • Die Plattform trägt das geplante Wachstum ohne Stabilitätsprobleme, und die Datenbasis ist im Unternehmen die anerkannte Wahrheit

das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung von Tech-Teams (ab ca. 3 Personen) – als Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager, Teamlead, Head of IT oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Einen soliden technischen Hintergrund als Entwicklerin oder Entwickler (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) – du hast selbst gebaut, was du heute verantwortest

  • Verantwortung über mehrere Disziplinenhinweg: Du hast nicht nur Entwicklung geführt, sondern auch mit Daten und/oder Infrastruktur zu tun gehabt

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, GCP oder Azure), CI/CD und modernen Web- und Plattform-Architekturen

  • Ein sicheres Gefühl für Priorisierung: Du kannst begründet Nein sagen und hältst auch dann Kurs, wenn mehrere Bereiche gleichzeitig etwas von dir wollen

  • Erfahrung darin, Prozesse einzuführen, die tatsächlich gelebt werden – ohne das Team in Bürokratie zu ersticken

  • Ein datengetriebener Arbeitsstil: Du misst, bevor du entscheidest, und machst Ergebnisse für andere nachvollziehbar

  • Kommunikationsstärke Richtung Nicht-Techniker: Du kannst Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung erklären, warum etwas dauert – so, dass es verstanden und akzeptiert wird

  • Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsstärke: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, sondern erkennst selbst, was zu tun ist

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up, Scale-up oder Agentur) ist ein klarer Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung mit Lead-Generierung, Performance Marketing oder B2B-SaaS ist ein Bonus, aber keine Voraussetzung

was uns wichtig ist

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100 % im Home Office erledigt werden. Für Team-Events und Quartalsplanung freuen wir uns über ca. 1–2 Präsenztage pro Quartal in unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt (Reisekosten übernehmen wir).

  • Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und bist Teil des erweiterten Führungskreises.

  • Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in unbefristeter Anstellung.

  • Diese Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt: Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur laufen bei dir zusammen.

das bieten wir dir

  • Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
  • Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
  • Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
  • Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
  • Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
  • Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
  • Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
  • Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
  • Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings, wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
  • Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
  • Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
  • Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.

das sind unsere werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.

  • Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.

  • Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

raw.description:
About Us

CipherHealth is an award winning software company committed to enhancing care coordination and outcomes across the continuum. Since 2009, CipherHealth’s automated, scalable platform has empowered healthcare organizations to engage patients and care teams at every touchpoint, streamlining workflows and improving experiences. With tailored communication solutions powered by AI and deep integrations, CipherHealth drives better clinical results, operational efficiency, and financial sustainability, transforming healthcare one interaction at a time.

Account Executive

We are looking for a self-motivated, driven, and passionate Executive Sales Professional to join our sales effort in the Health Systems space (acute care, ambulatory care, etc) for our solutions and services. This role covers the full sales cycle, from lead identification through contract negotiation and signing, account transition to services, ongoing support, and follow-on sales, including expansion, cross-sell & upsell. This position reports to the Chief Sales Officer, or their designee. The ideal candidate has a passion for healthcare, a strong drive for success, process orientation, a demonstrated ability to identify, qualify and close new opportunities, and a documented track record of results. Please note that this is an Individual Contributor role.


Responsibilities

  • Run the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and contract execution
  • Lead executive-level conversations with CMOs, CNOs, CFOs, and CIOs, connecting our solutions to their strategic goals
  • Meet and exceed quota; maintain a pipeline of 5X assigned quota in CRM at all times
  • Diagnose prospect challenges, build business cases, and develop clear ROI narratives that drive decisions
  • Build and execute multi-threaded deal strategies — stakeholder mapping, objection handling, procurement navigation, and budget alignment
  • Develop research-driven account plans that identify buying triggers, key stakeholders, and budget cycles
  • Prospect consistently within assigned territory using a disciplined, data-informed approach
  • Collaborate with your SDR partner on joint outreach and account coverage plans
  • Drive expansion, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within existing accounts
  • Deliver accurate, stage-appropriate forecasts to Sales leadership with supporting deal detail in CRM
  • Maintain real-time CRM hygiene across all calls, meetings, stage changes, and close plan activity
  • Surface risks and blockers early, always paired with a recommended path forward
  • Partner with Solution Engineering, Customer Success, and Product to deliver tailored demos and proposals
  • Represent CipherHealth at industry conferences and clinical forums
  • Stay current on healthcare trends, regulatory shifts, and the competitive landscape

Qualifications:

  • 8–15 years of enterprise outside sales experience, with at least 5 years in acute care or health system environments
  • Proven quota attainment in complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 6–18 month sales cycles
  • Ability to independently develop, advance, and close six-figure deals
  • Executive presence and communication skills at the C-suite level
  • CRM proficiency and disciplined pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)
  • Experience navigating health system procurement, legal, and compliance processes
  • Ability to travel 40–50% within the assigned territory

Preferred

  • Experience selling patient engagement, care coordination, or clinical workflow SaaS
  • Familiarity with value-based care, HCAHPS, and hospital quality improvement
  • Background in consulting, clinical operations, or healthcare IT advisory
  • Trained in MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, or a comparable enterprise sales methodology

Compensation:

Base Salary: $130,000 - $150,000 + commissions and equity

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At CipherHealth, we believe every candidate is unique and are dedicated to building an inclusive workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate!

You will never be asked to conduct a text message interview, submit payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. All emails from CipherHealth will come from "@cipherhealth.com" email addresses. Any emails from other email addresses are scams. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication and contact the FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. If you'd like to verify the legitimacy of an email you've received from CipherHealth recruiting, forward it to .

We kindly request that you do not contact us by phone regarding this job posting. Our phone lines are specifically for customers needing immediate support. Our hiring team carefully reviews all applications submitted through our careers page, and we'll reach out to candidates directly if there’s a match. Thank you for your understanding and patience!

How We Invest In You

  • Healthcare that begins on your first day:
    • Generous company-funding of our health, vision, and dental plans
    • HSA/FSA plans
    • Short and Long-Term Disability
    • Life and Personal Accident Insurance
    • $40 monthly wellness stipend you can use towards any wellness, fitness, and wellbeing purchases
    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Adoption Assistance
  • Retirement: 401(k) at three months of employment — with a match upon enrollment!
  • Time away:
    • Discretionary PTO + 13 paid holidays
    • Parenthood: Competitive paid parental leave and flexible return to work policy
  • Recognition:
    • Generous Employee Referral Program - earn cash for each employee referral that is hired
    • Yearly Cipher-versary stipend
    • Ci-Phives - receive public kudos and gift cards from peers and managers
  • Culture:
    • CARE2 Values
    • Monthly All Teams Meetings
    • Employee Resource Groups such as Rainbow Room and BIPOC Group
    • Internal Webinars and robust onboarding / training programs
    • Remote-first team: $50 per month reimbursement in your check for WFH expenses
    • You’ll receive a new Macbook laptop, other hardware, and company swag upon hire

About this Job

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Vice President of Commercial Solutions Sales to lead a high-performing team responsible for driving revenue growth, client expansion, and sales excellence across a portfolio of data, analytics, and insights solutions.

This executive leader will partner closely with product, consulting, customer success, and commercial leadership teams to help enterprise clients transform business decisions through data-driven insights and advanced analytics. The role requires a proven sales leader with experience managing complex solution sales, developing top talent, and building strong executive-level relationships within large enterprise organizations.

Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of quota-carrying sales professionals.

  • Establish clear performance expectations, sales metrics, and accountability measures.

  • Recruit, onboard, and retain top-performing commercial talent.

  • Provide coaching on complex sales strategy, executive engagement, negotiation, and value-based selling.

  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, growth, and continuous improvement.

Revenue Growth & Commercial Execution

  • Own team revenue performance across new business acquisition and account expansion.

  • Drive pipeline development and disciplined execution throughout the sales lifecycle.

  • Deliver accurate forecasting and business planning.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop strategic sales initiatives and market growth plans.

  • Identify opportunities to accelerate revenue growth through innovative commercial strategies.

Executive Client Engagement

  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers across client organizations.

  • Support development of customized business solutions aligned to client objectives.

  • Guide commercial strategy, deal structuring, pricing, and negotiations.

  • Help teams articulate differentiated value propositions that address complex business challenges.

  • Act as an executive sponsor for key client relationships and strategic opportunities.

  • 8-10+ years of consultative B2B sales experience with data, analytics, technology, SaaS, research, information services, or related solutions.

  • 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.

  • Experience with leading consumer intelligence, market measurement, analytics, insights, or data solutions used by enterprise brands and retailers

  • Proven success selling into consumer-focused industries, including retail, consumer goods, or adjacent sectors.

  • Experience leading complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence C-suite decision makers.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue goals and driving sustainable growth.

  • Experience managing forecasting, pipeline performance, and territory planning.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving, and highly collaborative environment.

  • Familiarity with leading market intelligence, consumer insights, analytics, measurement, or data platforms is strongly preferred.

Help Power the Future

AECOM is seeking a Sr. Lead Substation Engineer to join our growing Energy practice in a remote role based anywhere in the United States. This position offers the opportunity to lead the design and delivery of critical transmission, distribution, renewable energy, and grid modernization projects while working alongside some of the industry's top engineering professionals.

As a technical leader within AECOM's Power Delivery team, you will play a key role in helping utilities and energy clients navigate an evolving energy landscape by delivering innovative, reliable, and resilient substation solutions.

Whether supporting grid expansion, renewable energy integration, or infrastructure modernization, you'll have the flexibility of a remote work environment while contributing to impactful projects across North America.

The Opportunity

As a Sr. Lead Substation Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the planning, design, and delivery of utility-scale substation projects. Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and project managers, you will support projects from concept development through construction while ensuring technical excellence, quality, and client satisfaction.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and building strong client relationships while contributing to the continued growth of AECOM's Energy business.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the engineering and design of transmission and distribution substation projects for utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight for substation physical design, protection and control integration, grounding systems, equipment layouts, and power delivery infrastructure.

  • Support the development and review of one-line diagrams, protection schemes, equipment specifications, construction packages, and design documentation.

  • Apply engineering expertise throughout project phases including planning, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement, and construction support.

  • Support engineering studies and analyses related to grounding, equipment sizing, fault current evaluations, and substation design considerations.

  • Stay current with evolving technologies, industry standards, and utility practices related to substations, grid modernization, and power delivery systems.

  • Build standards across processes and practices.

Project Delivery

  • Lead engineering tasks and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality work on schedule and within budget.

  • Support project planning, resource coordination, technical reviews, and project execution activities.

  • Provide technical oversight for substation upgrades, expansions, brownfield modifications, and greenfield projects.

  • Collaborate with project managers to identify and mitigate risks while maintaining project objectives and client expectations.

  • Support construction activities through technical consultation, design clarifications, and resolution of field issues.

Client Engagement & Business Development

  • Build strong relationships with utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients.

  • Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, presentations, and project reviews.

  • Support proposal development, scope definition, cost estimates, and pursuit efforts.

  • Identify opportunities to expand services and strengthen long-term client partnerships.

  • Collaborate with regional and national teams to support strategic growth initiatives.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Mentor engineers and designers while supporting technical development and knowledge sharing.

  • Collaborate with civil, structural, transmission, protection and control, and program management teams.

  • Contribute to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the Energy practice.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, safety, and collaboration.

Why AECOM

AECOM is the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle. Our Energy practice helps clients modernize the electric grid, integrate renewable energy resources, improve reliability, and support the transition to a more sustainable future.

As part of AECOM, you'll enjoy:

  • Remote work flexibility.

  • Opportunities to work on industry-leading energy projects.

  • Access to a global network of technical experts.

  • Career growth, leadership development, and professional training opportunities.

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • A collaborative culture focused on innovation, inclusion, and technical excellence.

Location: Remote (U.S.) with occasional travel based on project and client needs.

Join AECOM and help deliver the next generation of energy infrastructure.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with +12 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience supporting transmission and distribution substation projects.

  • Experience with electrical engineering principles, utility infrastructure, and power delivery systems.

  • Experience leading engineering tasks, reviewing technical deliverables, and coordinating project teams.

  • Experience and knowledge working with industry standards and codes such as IEEE, NESC, and NEC.

  • Experience with industry-standard engineering and design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, ETAP, Aspen, CAPE, or similar tools.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a remote environment.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for project, client, and team needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and client relationship skills.

  • Experience supporting utility, renewable energy, grid modernization, or energy transition projects.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical leadership initiatives.

  • Familiarity with substation physical design, protection and control systems, SCADA integration, or related power system applications.

  • Sponorship is not available for this role
  • Relocation is not available for this role

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
