raw.description:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

The Operations Program Manager will be the central coordinator for scheduled operational activities affecting customers, production services and managed CPE fleets. You will maintain the authoritative global operations calendar and make sure every planned deployment, maintenance window, firmware rollout, migration, customer activity and operational event has the right scope, resources, dependencies, approvals, communications and execution plan.

Reporting to the Operations Manager and the Director of Network Operations, you will connect customer project managers and internal program managers with Support, NOC, DevOps, Engineering, QA, Product and other delivery teams. Your success is measured by predictable execution, early conflict detection, clear accountability and fewer customer-impacting surprises; not by simply scheduling meetings or maintaining a project plan.

Role mandate

  • Own the integrated schedule and coordination process for planned operational activities across regions, customers, services and technical teams.

  • Maintain one authoritative global calendar that shows activity windows, customer commitments, resource assignments, dependencies, conflicts, risk and status.

  • Drive each activity from intake through readiness, execution, validation, customer handoff and closure using clear milestones and accountable owners.

  • Align Support, NOC, SRE, DevOps, Engineering and other required resources without taking over their technical decisions or people-management responsibilities.

  • Provide leaders, customers and delivery teams with timely, accurate visibility into the forward schedule, capacity constraints, risks, decisions and outcomes.

What you will own

Global Operations Calendar & Portfolio Control

  • Maintain the single authoritative calendar for all scheduled operational work across customers, regions, and time zones — capturing activity type, scope, risk tier, dependencies, owners, and readiness status.
  • Identify and resolve scheduling collisions (shared resources, freeze periods, overlapping changes) before commitments are finalized.
  • Publish forward-looking views (24hr / 7-day / 30-day / quarterly) filterable by customer, region, service, and team.

Activity Intake, Planning & Readiness

  • Set intake process and minimum lead times for deployments, migrations, firmware rollouts, and other planned work.
  • Turn requests into integrated activity plans (milestones, entry/exit criteria, sequencing, rollback, communications, closure).
  • Run readiness reviews to confirm approvals, runbooks, test evidence, and monitoring are in place.
  • Track decisions, risks, and dependencies; escalate gaps early with clear options and owners.

Customer & Program-Manager Coordination

  • Act as the operational planning counterpart to customer PMs for work affecting their services or devices.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of customer maintenance windows, contacts, and escalation paths.
  • Align internal program timelines with the operations calendar, ensuring sufficient lead time.
  • Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints while leaving technical decisions to accountable owners.

Cross-Functional Resource Orchestration

  • Identify required skills/coverage from Support, NOC, SRE, DevOps, Engineering, QA, and other teams for each activity.
  • Secure resource commitments (primary + backup) and track coverage through execution and post-activity monitoring.
  • Flag double-booking, fatigue, and single-person dependencies; coordinate handoffs across time zones and shifts.

Execution Coordination & Communications

  • Facilitate kickoffs, checkpoints, and completion reviews for high-impact work.
  • Define communication plans (audience, channel, cadence, owner) for customers, leadership, and technical teams.
  • Monitor milestones and risks in real time, triggering escalation when windows are at risk.
  • Confirm validation, documentation, and handoff before closing out an activity.

Governance, Reporting & Improvement

  • Report on upcoming work, conflicts, resource gaps, and outcomes.
  • Track metrics: on-time readiness, schedule adherence, rollback rate, change-caused incidents, communication timeliness.
  • Lead post-activity reviews and turn lessons into process/tooling improvements.
  • Partner with OSS Engineers to improve calendar and workflow tools while retaining process ownership.

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 3 years coordinating technical operations, cloud, network, telecom, SaaS or production-service activities.

  • Demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional schedules involving external customers and multiple internal technical teams.

  • Experience maintaining integrated plans, global calendars, resource forecasts, dependencies, risk registers, decisions, action logs and executive status reporting.

  • Strong understanding of production change, maintenance, deployment or release coordination, including readiness, implementation, validation, rollback and closure.

  • Ability to understand technical dependencies and ask effective questions across cloud services, infrastructure, software, networks and device operations without needing to be the technical implementer.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication with the judgment to tailor updates for customers, executives, program managers and technical responders.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve competing priorities, hold owners accountable and escalate constructively with evidence and options.

  • Strong organization and attention to detail across concurrent activities, regions and time zones, including calm execution during changing conditions.

  • Experience with project/program tools,change-management systems, shared calendars, dashboards and collaboration platforms.

  • Experience with Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Monday.com, Asana or comparable planning and workflow platforms.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a service-provider, broadband, telecom, managed-network, cloud-platform or multi-tenant SaaS environment.

  • Experience coordinating production deployments, maintenance, migrations, customer cutovers, firmware rollouts or other controlled technical activities.

  • Working familiarity with cloud services, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, APIs, databases and messaging platforms.

  • Understanding of managed CPE environments involving broadband gateways, routers, ONTs, Wi-Fi/mesh systems, device onboarding, telemetry and firmware lifecycle.

  • Experience coordinating with 24×7 NOC, Support, SRE, DevOps and Engineering teams and planning safe handoffs across shifts and regions.

  • Experience creating portfolio-level calendar and resource dashboards using BI or reporting tools.

  • Familiarity with ITIL change enablement, release management, service transition, incident management and problem management.

  • PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, ITIL or comparable program, project or service-management certification.

  • Experience working directly with customer project managers and presenting readiness or risk to customer leadership.

Working expectations

  • Coordinate globally distributed stakeholders and work across time zones; normal hours will vary when customer or production windows require coverage.

  • Provide Occasional evening or weekend meetings for critical activities tracking, plus occasional travel.

  • Maintain strong boundaries between program coordination and technical execution while remaining present through critical go/no-go and escalation points.

  • Travel occasionally for customer planning, major operational events or team workshops when required.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team works directly with impacted merchants to resolve technical incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.

What you’ll do

You'll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying complex patterns of fraud during incidents. You will lead incident response for product abuse and fraud events, conducting deep-dive analyses to identify root causes. By collaborating cross-functionally, you will drive improvements that enhance our fraud detection and prevention strategies at scale. Your expertise will be essential in automating response processes through agentic approaches, allowing us to safeguard merchants and neutralize threats with speed and precision.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response.
  • As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) to standardize threat intelligence.
  • Lead incident root cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems and strategies, leveraging the FT3 framework, data-driven model to drive enhancements and process improvements for emerging fraud risks.
  • Streamline incident response capabilities, ensuring the tooling and processes are clear, accurate and efficient
  • Work cross-functionally with security, fraud and data science teams to build agentic solutions for responding to abuse incidents at scale
  • Effectively communicate cross-functionally with legal and policy teams to assess and mitigate risks, while demonstrating strong problem-solving under pressure.
  • Collaborate effectively with teammates, leading projects, mentoring others, and developing and championing quality standards within the team

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience conducting incident response in security, product abuse or trust domains
  • 3+ years experience analyzing large data sets to solve problems and/or building models with a behavioral approach to fraud detection
  • B.S. or M.S. Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages
  • Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations
  • Ability to communicate results clearly and focus on impact
  • Ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment

Preferred qualifications

    • An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors.
    • Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.)
    • Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.)
    • Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment
    • Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges

Job title: Partnerships Program Specialist

Full-time Position Salary: Base: $58,000/yr, Commission: $15,000/yr (OTE: $73,000/yr) plus benefits

Who We Are

At Otto, we're on a mission to create a world where both veterinarians and pet parents have peace of mind. We build technology and services that enable veterinary teams to deliver high-quality care, so vets and pet parents can enjoy the highest quality of life. We're a fast-paced startup full of passionate, entrepreneurially-minded people excited to build an amazing place to work. If that inspires you, please apply!

What You’ll Do

As a Partnerships Program Specialist, you own a pipeline of veterinary practices and you're measured on enrollments. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, you'll spend your day on the phone and in your inbox positioning Otto's free partner programs to clinic owners and decision-makers, handling objections, and walking prospects through the enrollment workflow and terms of service until they're signed up. Enrollment is only half the job — you'll also drive each practice to complete integration with our data partner, since clinics only count toward quota once they're fully integrated.

This is a sales seat. You'll need to quickly build rapport with veterinarians and practice managers, tie our programs to outcomes they care about, work past the usual stalls ("send me something," "not right now," "we'll think about it"), and ask for the enrollment.

Opportunity to move to full-time after showing strong performance and quota attainment for first 60 days.

Who You Are

  • At least 1 year of quota-carrying sales experience (SaaS preferred); able to speak to a pipeline you owned and a number you hit
  • Comfortable on the phone all day and unfazed by objections
  • Highly motivated, competitive, and self-disciplined
  • Confident, energetic communicator
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator
  • Experience selling into the veterinary space is a plus
  • Driven by a passion for winning — and constant learning as we build a better veterinary experience together

Duties and responsibilities include:

  • Own a pipeline of veterinary clinics from first conversation through completed enrollment and integration
  • Make a minimum of 55 outbound calls per day plus follow-up email and messaging
  • Position Otto's partner programs, handle objections, and guide prospects through the enrollment workflow and T&C signing
  • Drive enrolled clinics through integration with our data partner — quota credit lands when integration is complete
  • Hit and exceed monthly enrollment goals
  • Keep activity and pipeline clean in Salesforce, Salesloft, and the rest of our sales stack
  • Partner with internal teams for a smooth handoff post-integration
Remote, US-based. Austin, TX preferred.

Due to state SaaS tax laws, we're not able to hire in AZ, NM, SD, TN, AL, KY, WV, SC, PA, NY, ME, RI, WA, or DC, but we are actively hiring in Texas and all other US states.

Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Banks, acquirers, PSPs, and wallets use Yuno to modernize their infrastructure without replacing core systems and to prepare for the next generation of commerce, including agentic payments.

About The Role

We are looking for a Partnerships Manager to join our growing North America team. In this role, you will own and grow a strategic portfolio of partners — including acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), banks, and fraud & risk solution providers — driving integrations, co-selling initiatives, and long-term commercial relationships.

This is a cross-functional, high-visibility role sitting at the intersection of business development, product, and commercial strategy. You will be the primary point of contact for your partner portfolio and a key driver of Yuno's ecosystem growth in the region.

Your contribution will be

Partner Portfolio Management

  • Own end-to-end relationships with a defined portfolio of North America partners across acquirers, APMs, banks, and fraud/risk vendors.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact, ensuring partners are engaged, enabled, and growing within the Yuno ecosystem.

  • Monitor partner health metrics (integration status, volume, NPS) and proactively address issues.

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities aligned with Yuno's product and commercial strategy.

  • Negotiate partnership agreements, commercial terms, and SLAs in collaboration with legal and finance teams.

  • Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-marketing campaigns, and referral programs with strategic partners.

  • Contribute with Yuno's sales pipeline through lead generation coming from partners

  • Identify commercial opportunities, own and convert 2e2 commercial partner deal cycle

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Product team to advocate for partner requirements and prioritize integrations.

  • Coordinate with Sales and Customer Success teams to leverage the partner network in merchant acquisition and retention.

  • Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, partner capabilities, and North America payment trends.

  • Attending industry events to leverage Yuno's brand and connect with the payments ecosystem.

Enablement & Onboarding

  • Lead the onboarding of new partners, coordinating technical and commercial workstreams.

  • Develop and maintain partner enablement materials, playbooks, and training resources.

  • Organize QBRs, partner summits, and joint planning sessions to align on priorities and pipeline.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior commercial role within the payments, fintech, or financial services industry.

  • Demonstrated track record of independently managing strategic partner relationships with acquirers, payment processors, APMs, banks, or fraud solution providers — including commercial negotiations with senior and C-level stakeholders.

  • Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguity: identify opportunities, structure the approach, and convert into signed deals with minimal supervision.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level counterparts.

  • Ability to manage multiple strategic relationships simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Data-driven mindset with ability to define, track, and report on partnership KPIs.

  • Commercial ability to identify opportunities with partners and convert into real deals.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, own and convert e2e commercial partner deal cycle

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Legal, and Commercial teams

What We Offer at Yuno

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform layer that powers large-scale AI training and inference workloads. The role focuses on GPU clusters, distributed training frameworks, scheduling, storage performance, and developer experience for ML engineers and researchers, with strong emphasis on reliability, efficiency, and cost control. The ideal candidate has built or operated production AI infrastructure at scale, understands the interaction between hardware, kernel, scheduler, and ML framework, and brings strong software engineering discipline to platform work.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate GPU and accelerator infrastructure for training and inference, spanning on-prem clusters, cloud-managed services, and hybrid configurations.
  • Build scheduling, queueing, and resource-sharing systems that maximize accelerator utilization across many teams.
  • Integrate frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, and Ray Train into a unified platform offering.
  • Operate high-performance storage systems and data pipelines that keep accelerators fed with training data at near-line-rate.
  • Design networking architectures supporting RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, and high-bandwidth collective communication.
  • Build observability for AI workloads including utilization, throughput, training stability, and failure-mode analytics.
  • Implement checkpointing, restart, and fault-tolerance patterns for long-running training jobs at scale.
  • Drive cost optimization across compute, storage, and networking through scheduling, spot capacity, and right-sizing.
  • Develop developer tooling and paved-road workflows that let researchers launch experiments safely and efficiently.
  • Partner with research and applied ML teams to plan capacity for upcoming training runs.
  • Implement security controls, isolation, and access management for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.
  • Drive automation across cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration enforcement.
  • Maintain runbooks, capacity dashboards, and operational documentation for the AI platform.
  • Stay current with AI infrastructure research, accelerator hardware, and emerging open-source AI tooling.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or HPC engineering.
  • Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or large-scale ML training infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language such as Go or C++.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training, accelerator architectures, and collective communication.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, or similar scheduling systems for ML workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, and high-performance storage.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider’s ML infrastructure offerings.
  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating InfiniBand or RDMA networking at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with custom orchestrators or research-grade training stacks.
  • Exposure to frontier model training operations.
  • Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

The ideal candidate will have strong PostgreSQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities:

  • Manage and optimize databases (PostgreSQL ,SQL Server, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities:

  • Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Competencies:

  • Strong PostgreSQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for PostgreSQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).
  • We are currently targeting candidates who are willing to work US EST hours
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Data Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA) at M3 Global Research, an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

LabX Media Group (LMG) is a leading global science publishing company, delivering trusted, timely, and in-depth content across print and digital platforms to empower researchers and advance scientific discovery.

We are looking for a dedicated Webinar & Conference Producer to join our dynamic team!

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual with a passion for science communication, webinar production, and event management. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the planning, coordination, and execution of webinars and online events. This role will involve sourcing speakers, curating scientific agendas, managing technical aspects, and ensuring an engaging virtual experience for audiences and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned webinars, editorial-led sessions, and online events across LMG.
  • Source high-quality speakers and develop industry-leading scientific event agendas.
  • Research scientific literature to ensure events focus on cutting-edge advancements in life sciences, drug discovery, and analytical chemistry.

  • Write promotional copy to support event marketing efforts.
  • Ensure seamless communication between clients, speakers, and internal teams.

  • Maintain real-time accuracy of data trackers and project management tools like Trello.
  • Attend weekly department meetings to provide updates on event progress.

Education & Experience

  • Previous experience in event production OR a bachelors degree in a scientific field (e.g., Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or related discipline).
  • Experience in a client-facing role and project management.
  • Marketing experience (desirable).
  • Understanding of the science industry (preferred).

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Technically adept and comfortable learning new software.
  • Excellent communication, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Outgoing and comfortable engaging with clients, scientists, and key opinion leaders
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated, able to work independently and collaboratively.

Application Procedure

This position is remotely based and is open to all eligible candidates in Canada. Preference may be given to candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone.

This job posting is for a current vacancy.

LabX Media Group is an enthusiastic equal opportunity employer that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering a culture where differences are valued and innovation thrives.

Reasonable accommodation is available for qualified individuals with disabilities, upon request when contacted for an interview. We thank all candidates for applying. Only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please note: Our hiring process does not involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) for candidate screening or decision-making. All evaluations are conducted by our human resources team and hiring managers.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research

  • Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
  • Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
  • Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans

Strategy & Execution

  • Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
  • Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
  • Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
  • Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
  • Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
  • Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
  • Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift
  • Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
  • Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly

Nice to Have

  • Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
  • Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
  • Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
  • Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Role Summary

The Director of Engineering leads Highland's engineering and design team — drafting, project engineering, and utility interconnection — that supports a fast-moving portfolio of EV charging, battery energy storage (BESS), and edge compute sites from qualified sites through construction-ready.

This leader owns the engineering standards, the design package content and quality gates, and the throughput of the entire function, and partners with Project Development to deliver build-ready sites at portfolio scale and on an aggressive timeline.

Reporting to the Vice President, Development & Construction, the Director builds and leads a team of internal and external engineering resources. The Director serves as Highland's senior technical authority on utility and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, owns the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget, and builds the standards, playbooks, and tooling that make design faster, more repeatable, and more cost-effective.

This position is remote with an expectation of approximately 10-15% travel.

Responsibilities Overview:

  • Lead and scale Highland's project engineering function — drafting, design engineering, and utility interconnection — with end-to-end accountability for taking a large portfolio of EV charging, BESS, and edge compute sites from qualified site to permit-ready and construction-ready.
  • Own the engineering function's throughput and quality: define the design package content and the internal approval gates for every stage — conceptual, 30%, Issued-for-Permit (IFP), and Issued for Construction (IFC) — and keep packages moving on an aggressive, portfolio-wide timeline.
  • Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of internal engineering resources
  • Own Highland's external engineering-partner strategy — select, contract, scale, and manage the performance of engineering design and interconnection consultants so that internal and external capacity flex with portfolio volume.
  • Set and enforce Highland's engineering, CAD, and design specifications and standards, and own the repositories of utility and AHJ requirements that make design compliant, consistent, and repeatable across the portfolio.
  • Serve as Highland's senior technical authority on utility interconnection and AHJ permitting across EV charging, BESS, and edge compute; resolve the most complex technical and jurisdictional issues and represent Highland's engineering position externally.
  • Own the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget — sequence and resource design, interconnection, and permitting milestones so each site is build-ready when construction needs it, and contribute to Highland's repeatable unit-cost installation model.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Development, Execution, Origination, Procurement, and Fleet Operations to align engineering with portfolio priorities and continuously improve the site-to-energized process.
  • Drive continuous improvement through tooling and process automation (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, template- and data-driven design) to increase design velocity and improve unit economics as the portfolio scales.
  • Provide engineering leadership on technical due diligence, estimating, and risk for new opportunities, supporting Origination and Development on feasibility, buildability, and cost.

Qualifications:

    Required

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline, or 12+ years of directly related professional experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive engineering experience in EV charging, renewable energy, power/electrical infrastructure, or utility-scale development, including design management from concept through construction.
  • 5+ years leading engineering teams, including managing managers and building or scaling a design organization.
  • Demonstrated ownership of engineering standards, design package content, and QA/QC across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
  • Proven experience selecting, contracting, and managing external engineering consultants at scale.
  • Deep working knowledge of utility interconnection, new electrical service, and AHJ permitting requirements.
  • Familiarity with interconnection standards and processes (e.g., IEEE 1547, utility tariffs, and interconnection rules).
  • Expertise with CAD-based design delivery (AutoCAD) and design/review tooling (Procore, Bluebeam).

    • Preferred

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Experience delivering EV charging infrastructure, BESS, and/or edge compute / data-center power projects.
  • Experience building repeatable, unit-cost-driven design programs in a high-growth environment.
  • Master's degree in engineering or an MBA.

What You Can Expect from Highland:

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
  • A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
  • Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) program and company match

In addition to federal law requirements, Highland Electric Fleets complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

FINN Partners is a fast-growing, global independent marketing agency recognized for its bold ideas and collaborative spirit. Our expertise spans integrated marketing, media, and creative services, offering clients a unified team focused on business and brand growth. The Performance Media team leads performance strategy across paid search, social, programmatic, and audience insights, while the Brand Media team leads brand strategy across narrative and channel selection. The two teams build every media plan together, aligned to a single business outcome. Media joins client engagements at the earliest stages, working alongside strategy and creative to develop one integrated campaign.

Position Summary
As Director of Brand Media, you will own brand media strategy across the agency's client roster, leading upper-funnel channel selection, narrative development, and innovation partnerships. You will build every media plan in lockstep with the Performance Media team, ensuring brand and performance are planned as one connected, interdependent system.
You will manage and develop the Brand Media team, own new business planning for brand media, and represent FINN's media perspective and point of view externally. You will surface media landscape insights and media channel context in the strategy brief, shaping how campaigns come to life from the outset.

What You'll Do
  • Lead brand media strategy and channel selection across multiple client accounts, ensuring narrative and channel choices connect directly to business objectives
  • Partner with the Performance Media team to build every plan as one integrated system, aligned to a single business outcome
  • Champion integration between Brand Media, Account, Strategy, and Creative teams throughout client planning and development
  • Interrogate the client brief, evaluating whether it's asking the right questions and grounded in the right audiences and objectives
  • Lead relationships and negotiations for custom media vehicles, sponsorships, franchise opportunities, and emerging partnership formats
  • Develop thought leadership and market perspective applicable across clients, establishing a distinct FINN point of view
  • Represent FINN's media expertise externally, including client presentations, new business pitches, panels, and industry platforms
  • Lead new business planning for brand media, partnering with senior media colleagues on client retention
  • Champion the use of AI and automation across planning, strategy development, and reporting
  • Manage and develop the Brand Media team: interview, hire, delegate, mentor, conduct performance reviews, and recommend compensation decisions
  • Evaluate staff development needs in terms of rotation and promotion, ensuring role definition keeps pace with the team's growth
  • Coordinate with Account leads on day-to-day client direction, while retaining ownership of your team's development, performance management, and discipline standards
What You'll Bring
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of media, brand strategy, advertising agency, client-side, or publisher-side experience
  • Proven experience leading brand media strategy and channel planning across multiple accounts
  • Experience across brand channel formats: premium video (linear/CTV/streaming), programmatic video and display (DSP), audio, OOH, brand partnerships, integrations, sponsorships, brand social, emerging media, and custom activations
  • Experience managing significant client budgets and investment decisions
  • Strong leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career pathing for a growing team

  • Familiarity with audience research and competitive intelligence platforms such as GWI and MediaRadar, or similar tools
  • Experience with social listening and publishing platforms such as Sprout Social, or similar tools, given Brand Media's ownership of brand social
Knowledge & Skill Requirements
  • Strong understanding of the brand marketing funnel and upper-funnel channel strategy
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel and Slides/PowerPoint
  • Ability to translate media strategy into clear, compelling narrative for senior client stakeholders
  • Comfort partnering with Account leads and cross-functional teams outside your direct reporting line
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the initiative to challenge clients and internal teams to raise the bar
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines
Where You’ll Work
Anywhere in the U.S. We're a remote-first workplace with optional in-office days in Boston, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York, Portland, Washington DC, and more. Eastern Time Zone working hours are preferred to best align with team and client collaboration hours.

Anticipated Salary: $130,000 - $150,000. Compensation is based on experience and depending upon workplace location.

Why Join FINN Partners?

Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

raw.title: Product Marketing Associate, Rewards
raw.excerpt: About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research

  • Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
  • Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
  • Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans

Strategy & Execution

  • Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
  • Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
  • Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
  • Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
  • Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
  • Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
  • Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift
  • Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
  • Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly

Nice to Have

  • Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
  • Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
  • Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
  • Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.excerpt: About UsHighland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets.
raw.description:
About Us

Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Role Summary

The Director of Engineering leads Highland's engineering and design team — drafting, project engineering, and utility interconnection — that supports a fast-moving portfolio of EV charging, battery energy storage (BESS), and edge compute sites from qualified sites through construction-ready.

This leader owns the engineering standards, the design package content and quality gates, and the throughput of the entire function, and partners with Project Development to deliver build-ready sites at portfolio scale and on an aggressive timeline.

Reporting to the Vice President, Development & Construction, the Director builds and leads a team of internal and external engineering resources. The Director serves as Highland's senior technical authority on utility and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, owns the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget, and builds the standards, playbooks, and tooling that make design faster, more repeatable, and more cost-effective.

This position is remote with an expectation of approximately 10-15% travel.

Responsibilities Overview:

  • Lead and scale Highland's project engineering function — drafting, design engineering, and utility interconnection — with end-to-end accountability for taking a large portfolio of EV charging, BESS, and edge compute sites from qualified site to permit-ready and construction-ready.
  • Own the engineering function's throughput and quality: define the design package content and the internal approval gates for every stage — conceptual, 30%, Issued-for-Permit (IFP), and Issued for Construction (IFC) — and keep packages moving on an aggressive, portfolio-wide timeline.
  • Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of internal engineering resources
  • Own Highland's external engineering-partner strategy — select, contract, scale, and manage the performance of engineering design and interconnection consultants so that internal and external capacity flex with portfolio volume.
  • Set and enforce Highland's engineering, CAD, and design specifications and standards, and own the repositories of utility and AHJ requirements that make design compliant, consistent, and repeatable across the portfolio.
  • Serve as Highland's senior technical authority on utility interconnection and AHJ permitting across EV charging, BESS, and edge compute; resolve the most complex technical and jurisdictional issues and represent Highland's engineering position externally.
  • Own the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget — sequence and resource design, interconnection, and permitting milestones so each site is build-ready when construction needs it, and contribute to Highland's repeatable unit-cost installation model.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Development, Execution, Origination, Procurement, and Fleet Operations to align engineering with portfolio priorities and continuously improve the site-to-energized process.
  • Drive continuous improvement through tooling and process automation (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, template- and data-driven design) to increase design velocity and improve unit economics as the portfolio scales.
  • Provide engineering leadership on technical due diligence, estimating, and risk for new opportunities, supporting Origination and Development on feasibility, buildability, and cost.

Qualifications:

    Required

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline, or 12+ years of directly related professional experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive engineering experience in EV charging, renewable energy, power/electrical infrastructure, or utility-scale development, including design management from concept through construction.
  • 5+ years leading engineering teams, including managing managers and building or scaling a design organization.
  • Demonstrated ownership of engineering standards, design package content, and QA/QC across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
  • Proven experience selecting, contracting, and managing external engineering consultants at scale.
  • Deep working knowledge of utility interconnection, new electrical service, and AHJ permitting requirements.
  • Familiarity with interconnection standards and processes (e.g., IEEE 1547, utility tariffs, and interconnection rules).
  • Expertise with CAD-based design delivery (AutoCAD) and design/review tooling (Procore, Bluebeam).

    • Preferred

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Experience delivering EV charging infrastructure, BESS, and/or edge compute / data-center power projects.
  • Experience building repeatable, unit-cost-driven design programs in a high-growth environment.
  • Master's degree in engineering or an MBA.

What You Can Expect from Highland:

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
  • A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
  • Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) program and company match
Highland Electric Fleets provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Highland Electric Fleets complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
