About FINN Partners

FINN Partners is a fast-growing, global independent marketing agency recognized for its bold ideas and collaborative spirit. Our expertise spans integrated marketing, media, and creative services, offering clients a unified team focused on business and brand growth. The Performance Media team leads performance strategy across paid search, social, programmatic, and audience insights, while the Brand Media team leads brand strategy across narrative and channel selection. The two teams build every media plan together, aligned to a single business outcome. Media joins client engagements at the earliest stages, working alongside strategy and creative to develop one integrated campaign.

Position Summary
As Director of Brand Media, you will own brand media strategy across the agency's client roster, leading upper-funnel channel selection, narrative development, and innovation partnerships. You will build every media plan in lockstep with the Performance Media team, ensuring brand and performance are planned as one connected, interdependent system.
You will manage and develop the Brand Media team, own new business planning for brand media, and represent FINN's media perspective and point of view externally. You will surface media landscape insights and media channel context in the strategy brief, shaping how campaigns come to life from the outset.

What You'll Do
  • Lead brand media strategy and channel selection across multiple client accounts, ensuring narrative and channel choices connect directly to business objectives
  • Partner with the Performance Media team to build every plan as one integrated system, aligned to a single business outcome
  • Champion integration between Brand Media, Account, Strategy, and Creative teams throughout client planning and development
  • Interrogate the client brief, evaluating whether it's asking the right questions and grounded in the right audiences and objectives
  • Lead relationships and negotiations for custom media vehicles, sponsorships, franchise opportunities, and emerging partnership formats
  • Develop thought leadership and market perspective applicable across clients, establishing a distinct FINN point of view
  • Represent FINN's media expertise externally, including client presentations, new business pitches, panels, and industry platforms
  • Lead new business planning for brand media, partnering with senior media colleagues on client retention
  • Champion the use of AI and automation across planning, strategy development, and reporting
  • Manage and develop the Brand Media team: interview, hire, delegate, mentor, conduct performance reviews, and recommend compensation decisions
  • Evaluate staff development needs in terms of rotation and promotion, ensuring role definition keeps pace with the team's growth
  • Coordinate with Account leads on day-to-day client direction, while retaining ownership of your team's development, performance management, and discipline standards
What You'll Bring
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of media, brand strategy, advertising agency, client-side, or publisher-side experience
  • Proven experience leading brand media strategy and channel planning across multiple accounts
  • Experience across brand channel formats: premium video (linear/CTV/streaming), programmatic video and display (DSP), audio, OOH, brand partnerships, integrations, sponsorships, brand social, emerging media, and custom activations
  • Experience managing significant client budgets and investment decisions
  • Strong leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career pathing for a growing team
  • A track record of gaining trust through sound judgment, including under pressure or ambiguity
  • Experience partnering with performance media counterparts to build genuinely integrated plans across brand and performance
  • Experience collaborating across multiple disciplines, such as creative, strategy, SEO/GEO, web development, and PR, within a full-service agency or an integrated client-side marketing organization
  • Strong new business pitch experience, from strategic ideation through proposal development and delivery
  • Strong client-facing storytelling and presentation skills, able to translate complex strategy for varied audiences
  • Proficiency with FINN's reporting and dashboard platforms, including Ninjacat and Funnel, or similar tools
  • Familiarity with AI tools used across the agency, including Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, and Claude, to support planning, research, and reporting workflows
  • Familiarity with audience research and competitive intelligence platforms such as GWI and MediaRadar, or similar tools
  • Experience with social listening and publishing platforms such as Sprout Social, or similar tools, given Brand Media's ownership of brand social
Knowledge & Skill Requirements
  • Strong understanding of the brand marketing funnel and upper-funnel channel strategy
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel and Slides/PowerPoint
  • Ability to translate media strategy into clear, compelling narrative for senior client stakeholders
  • Comfort partnering with Account leads and cross-functional teams outside your direct reporting line
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the initiative to challenge clients and internal teams to raise the bar
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines
Where You’ll Work
Anywhere in the U.S. We're a remote-first workplace with optional in-office days in Boston, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York, Portland, Washington DC, and more. Eastern Time Zone working hours are preferred to best align with team and client collaboration hours.

Anticipated Salary: $130,000 - $150,000. Compensation is based on experience and depending upon workplace location.

Why Join FINN Partners?
  • Competitive salary, health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO policy, plus paid holidays
  • Wellness stipend for physical and mental health programs


How To Apply

Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary.
While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to those with whom we have a greater interest.

The Role

You'll own how Teramind is positioned, packaged, and sold. This is a senior, hands-on role at the center of our GTM engine: you'll define the messaging across four converging categories (IRM, DLP, AI Governance, employee monitoring), arm sales with what they need to win, and translate a fast-moving product roadmap into narratives the market cares about.

You'll also lead our creative production function - managing an AI-first content creator and building the systems that let a lean team produce at the volume and quality of one three times its size.

What You'll Do

Positioning & messaging

  • Own and continuously test core positioning across IRM, DLP, AI Governance, and employee monitoring - reconciling how buyers actually search and speak with how we show up on the site and in campaigns
  • Build persona and buyer-journey frameworks, and pressure-test them against real closed-won and closed-lost data - not assumptions

Sales enablement

  • Own the sales enablement stack: onboarding decks, demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and pricing/packaging narratives
  • Build and maintain competitive battlecards (Forcepoint, Microsoft Purview, ActivTrak, and others) and keep sales armed with fresh win/loss insight

Product launches & GTM

  • Partner with Product to translate the roadmap into GTM narratives, launch plans, and sales-facing collateral
  • Run and synthesize win/loss and churn interviews into messaging refinements and roadmap input

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in product marketing, including at least 3 years in B2B cybersecurity or adjacent enterprise SaaS
  • Proven ownership of positioning in a multi-category or category-creation environment
  • A track record of building sales enablement that sales teams actually use
  • Fluency in competitive intelligence — able to turn win/loss data into sharper messaging, not just reports
  • Experience managing creative or content talent, with genuine curiosity about AI-powered production workflows
  • Strong writing skills; you will be evaluated on this directly
  • Analyst relations experience (e.g., Gartner, Forrester)

Why This Role

You'll have real ownership at a company where marketing has a seat at the strategy table. The category is converging, the timing is right, and the person in this seat will shape how an entire market talks about insider risk in the AI era.

About Us

At Teramind, we're pioneering a predictive, AI-driven approach to safeguarding organizations' people, data, and operations. As a global leader in user behavior analytics, insider risk management, and workforce intelligence, we empower businesses to transform data into a strategic asset - delivering clear visibility, control, and proactive protection across digital environments.
We're open to hiring in just about every country in the world! Feel free to apply even if you don't live in the country listed in the job description.

Benefits

This is a remote role. Teramind has been a fully remote company since 2014, and for us that means real flexibility and teams that are genuinely global and diverse.
You'll also get:
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Laptop reimbursement
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities
  • Collaboration with a forward-thinking team where new ideas come to life, experience is valued, and talent is incubated. You can make an impact quickly.

Our Recruitment Process

We don’t expect you to check every box on the list. If you can picture yourself contributing to this team, we want to hear your story!
Most roles move through three interviews, though some can move quicker with fewer rounds. Leadership and technical roles may move through a more thorough process with multiple interview stages. All roles require reference and background checks.

Equal Opportunity

Teramind is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, participate on an interview, or perform this role, contact .

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

At JLL, we are driving sustainability through everything that we do, across all service lines and job positions. Specifically, we are growing our Sustainability practice to drive end-to-end sustainability solutions in real estate, from site selection to decommissioning.

In this role, you will work directly with one of our high-profile clients, acting as an embedded extension of their in-house Sustainability Team. As a member of the JLL Sustainable Operations Team with a deep knowledge of the needs of our client’s program, you will ensure they are capturing JLL’s full suite of sustainability services. You will act as an accelerator and partner-collaborator enabling our client to increase engagement across stakeholders and progress towards goals. You will ensure effective integration across business/functions throughout the real estate lifecycle influences behavioral changes, including change management ownership, required to achieve scope of work delivery and goals. This role requires a strategic and programmatic approach to embed sustainability thinking and practices across the real estate lifecycle.

This role oversees a global team of approximately 35 (and growing) sustainability professionals that will deliver Sustainable Operations products, solutions and tools. This role is a part of the Technical Services and Sustainable Operations (TSSO) Workplace management team at JLL.

We'll invest in your growth, support your wellbeing, and make sure you feel like you belong—because how we treat our people is how we deliver a brighter way for our clients.

Location: Seattle or Arlington strongly preferred.

This position is remote, U.S.-based.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGY DEVELOPMENT & DELIVERY

  • Deliver Results: Focuses heavily on bottom-line business metrics and large-scale outcomes rather than tracking incremental tasks.
  • Dive Deep: Maintains the ability to unearth root causes in critical operational dips while maintaining a wide strategic lens.
  • Invent and Simplify: Removes organizational friction and redesigns bloated processes into streamlined architectures
  • Systemic Problem Solving: Identifies structural gaps in processes and long-term trends, crafting strategies that scale far beyond a single team.
  • Single-Threaded Ownership: Takes absolute accountability for major programmatic outcomes across organizational boundaries with minimal oversight.
  • Design and implement a global platform delivery model aligned with client needs, quality targets, and delivery objectives
  • Work with Strategic Account executives to develop account delivery plans that support client retention, cross-selling, client satisfaction, and account growth
  • Develop and execute sustainability strategies and corresponding program components designed to optimize client sustainability performance in collaboration with client sustainability teams
  • Own and advance a multi-faceted global sustainability strategy with accountability across the client's real estate portfolio lifecycle

CLIENT LEADERSHIP & RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key clients and internal stakeholders (Business Line Leads, Client Relationship Managers, Sales teams, Account Directors)
  • Contribute to the client corporate sustainability strategy and drive the delivery of key objectives
  • Drive strategic direction and guidance on ways to enhance and expand service delivery, including leveraging supply chain partners, internal collaborations, and the broader JLL Sustainability Platform
  • Ensure high levels of execution and client satisfaction across all services, with focus on exceeding targets
  • Identify and drive actions at each phase of the real estate lifecycle aligned with client objectives
  • Bring applicable JLL tools and processes to the client for problem-solving and innovation
  • Advise clients on opportunities for JLL to support larger programmatic elements, providing solutions

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION & INTEGRATION

  • Effectively network cross-functionally with other JLL service lines (technology, finance, projects, IFM, consultants, procurement) to elevate sustainability outcomes for your client
  • Integrate feedback and remove roadblocks to accelerate innovation and service delivery
  • Create a solution-oriented environment where the team consistently identifies leading-edge best practices that deliver value while meeting account requirements and JLL processes
  • Establish strong working relationships with global and regional workstreams to deliver local targets as well as overarching global targets
  • With cross-functional view, effectively manage changes in partnership with stakeholders, which have the potential to impact sustainability objectives

TEAM LEADERSHIP & DEVELOPMENT

  • Lead and direct large global (AMER, EMEA, APAC) multifunctional teams in partnership with client teams.
  • Manage an effective, global sustainable operations team capable of delivery according to scope of work and schedule
  • Lead and grow an existing team of sustainability practitioners in lock-step with organizational and client demand growth
  • Develop a culture focused on client success, people development, teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation
  • Direct end-to-end employee management: hiring, onboarding, leading, developing, and mentoring team members
  • Diversify and develop the workforce to meet the evolution of client demand, with strong emphasis on technology skills
  • Drive consistency of delivery across the regional/global team including reporting requirements, policies, and procedures

FINANCIAL & OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE

  • Own P&L responsibility for account under management with demonstrated financial acumen: cost control, expenditure management, revenue forecasting, and key business metrics
  • Maintain accountability for cost management applicable to Platform elements and ensure efficiency as a percentage of revenue
  • Know your numbers and actively track financial performance against targets
  • Drive accountability for operational delivery, quality metrics, and business outcomes

COMMUNICATION, ADVOCACY & EXCELLENCE

  • Communicate robustly with key stakeholders to drive innovation, integration of feedback, and identification of opportunities
  • Ensure success stories are tracked, documented, and communicated to maximize awareness and engagement regarding the overall sustainability program and client success
  • Provide strategic input and lead program components (content development, maintenance, reporting) in assigned areas of expertise
  • Demonstrate innovative thinking and proactive management in bringing new ideas and solutions to the client; ensure effective rollout
  • Develop and enhance systems and processes for delivering best-practice sustainability performance and use of utility/sustainability management systems
  • Understand the implementation of sustainability across the commercial real estate lifecycle, including stakeholder roles, strategic decision-making, data tracking, and monitoring

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required Experience

  • University Degree, Prefer MBA (Science, engineering, math, or related fields)
  • Passionate about working towards a sustainable future
  • An excellent understanding of the key sustainability issues for corporate occupiers of real estate including, but not limited to; decarbonization, embodied carbon, circularity, resource preservation, biodiversity, climate risk, health & wellbeing, and social value creation
  • 10+ years Demonstrated experience in leading, managing, and influencing cross-functional teams
  • 10+ years Demonstrated experience with change management across multi-faceted situations and cross-functional teams; change management certification is desirable
  • Experience working with corporate clients, commercial property, property managers and an understanding of the landlord and tenant relationship is desirable
  • Excellent ability to build relationships with clients and their internal teams
  • A strong track record integrating sustainability into organizations’ operations
  • Experience working in a collaborative way with clients and other stakeholders to develop and implement ambitious and robust sustainability programs
  • Proven project and program management experience and excellent communication skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in written and numeric work
  • Ability to obtain buy-in and engagement from employees at all levels

Ready to shape a brighter way in sustainability? We'd love to hear from you—apply today.

raw.description:
Transform Digital Healthcare with Telstra Health

At Telstra Health, we're shaping the future of healthcare with connected solutions that make care safer, faster, and more seamless. From hospitals and clinics to aged care and community programs, our technology empowers teams to deliver better care—wherever it's needed.

Trusted across programs like 1800RESPECT, the Leaving Violence Program, and the National Cancer Screening Register, we connect care in ways that truly make a difference.

About the Leaving Violence Program

The Leaving Violence Program provides financial and other support to people who have left, or are leaving, a partner who uses violence. It is a Department of Social Services (DSS) funded national program delivered by Telstra Health.

The program is delivered in a person-centred and trauma-informed way, recognising the unique experiences of every individual. We are committed to culturally responsive practice, creating safe and inclusive services, and working collaboratively to support people to move forward with dignity, choice and respect.

About the role
We are inviting expressions of interest from individuals interested in a 12-month contract opportunity as a Support Line Specialist within the Leaving Violence Program. As the Support Line Specialist, you will provide trauma-informed guidance, mentoring, and operational support to practitioners responding to individuals impacted by family, domestic, and sexual violence.

You will be the point of real-time support for our frontline practitioners, offering expert advice on risk assessment, safety planning, and service responses. Importantly, you will also foster a culture of reflective practice by mentoring staff, facilitating learning conversations, and guiding practitioners through complex and high-risk cases.
If you are calm under pressure, an agile thinker, and bring strong family violence experience with a passion for supporting and developing others, we encourage you to apply.

What you'll be doing

Practitioner Support & Mentoring

  • Provide calm and immediate guidance to practitioners, ensuring their responses are trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and centred on victim-survivor safety and wellbeing.
  • Mentor staff through reflective conversations, supporting professional growth, confidence, and capability in responding to complex cases.
  • Encourage learning and reflective practice across the team, helping practitioners build resilience and share best practice approaches.

Real-Time Guidance

  • Support practitioners in navigating high-risk calls, including risk assessment, safety planning, and referral pathways.
    Provide clear decision-making support to practitioners in moments of complexity or crisis.
  • Ensure consistent application of trauma-informed, survivor-centred frameworks across service delivery.

Case Review & Approvals

  • Review and approve financial support packages, referrals, and escalated cases to ensure best-practice service standards.
  • Guide staff through appeals, escalations, and complex case decisions.
  • Monitor service delivery to identify risks, provide advice, and ensure accurate case management.

High-Risk Case Support

  • Provide immediate guidance on mandatory reporting obligations and escalation protocols.
  • Debrief and support practitioners following critical incidents or emotionally complex client interactions.
  • Model calm, professional, and trauma-informed practice during high-pressure scenarios.

About you
To succeed in this role, you will need to meet the following:

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling, Mental Health, or a related field.
  • Postgraduate qualification in Social Work, Psychology, or Counselling/Psychotherapy (or equivalent).

Membership

  • Registration or accreditation with at least one of the following:
  • Australian Counselling Association (ACA)
  • Australian Association of Social Workers (AASW)
  • Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA)
  • Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)
  • Australian Community Workers Association. (ACWA)

Checks

  • Current Working with Children Clearance (or ability to obtain before commencing).
  • Completion of a National Police Check (or ability to obtain before commencing).
  • Verification of the right to work in Australia. If qualifications were obtained overseas, formal verification within Australia by PBR (Professional Bodies Recognition) is required.

Experience

  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in FDSV services, including direct client support and safety planning.
  • At least 1 year in people management or operational coordination (e.g. real-time monitoring, quality assurance, complaints handling).
  • Strong knowledge of trauma-informed care, risk assessment, and safety planning for high-risk cases.

Skills

  • Ability to stay calm under pressure.
  • Agile and adaptive problem-solver.
  • Strong expertise in FDSV response.
  • Supportive mentor with reflective practice.
  • Skilled in building resilience, learning, and trauma-informed practice.

Perks & Benefits

  • Free Telstra mobile & plan (eligible employees only).
  • 25% off Telstra products & services.
  • 16 weeks paid gender-equal parental leave, plus additional leave options.
  • Career breaks, study support and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Free 24/7 professional support for you and your family.
  • Employee rewards program with discounts on shopping, gyms, movies, health insurance and more.

Work Schedule and Location

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

The Senior Accessibility Subject Matter Expert will serve as a senior strategic and technical authority for Section 508 compliance, accessibility governance, and Information and Communications Technology (ICT) quality assurance.

In this full-time role, you will perform high-level Section 508 testing of web content and electronic documents using Department of Homeland Security (DHS) approved assessment methods, conduct quality control reviews of test results completed by HQ 508 Program Trusted Testers, and provide end-to-end document remediation. Beyond testing and remediation, you will guide ICT project and acquisition efforts by evaluating Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) / Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs), advising project teams and senior management on accessibility risks throughout the System Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and serving as an operational back-up to the Government Section 508 Program.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Certifications:

    • Active DHS Trusted Tester Version 5.0 (or later) Certification required.

    • Active IAAP Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) Certification required.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

  • Technical Experience:

    • 7+ years of overall experience working in Information and Communications Technology (ICT) environments.

    • 2+ years of dedicated experience testing web electronic content and applications for conformance to Section 508 Standards.

    • 2+ years of dedicated experience testing and remediating electronic documents and forms (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe PDF) to Section 508 standards.

    • 3+ years of experience supporting ICT project and acquisition efforts by integrating Section 508 requirements across defined lifecycle stages.

  • Core Capabilities:

    • Quality Control & Review: Proven ability to conduct thorough quality checks and peer reviews of Section 508 test results submitted by HQ 508 Program Trusted Testers.

    • SDLC & Governance Advisory: Extensive experience advising project teams and senior leadership on Section 508 compliance, accessibility risk assessment, and technical remediation strategies throughout the system development lifecycle.

    • Acquisition & VPAT/ACR Evaluation: Technical expertise responding to complex accessibility inquiries during vendor product evaluations, including analyzing ACRs and VPATs.

    • Testing & Document Remediation: Advanced capability in developing accessibility test plans, interpreting test outputs, and performing hands-on remediation of complex electronic documents and forms using Federal CIO Council Community of Practice endorsed tests.

    • Programmatic Support: Ability to act as a reliable back-up to the Government Section 508 Program office as needed.

Why Join Team Carney?

When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

  • Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment.

  • Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).

  • Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.

Job Overview:

Cross business communication of resource requests that come from the centralized resource management mailbox. Required to interpret emails that come in from a centralized mailbox, determine where they should be routed. There are functional areas where daily interaction would be anticipated. First, for requestors within the business who are looking for resources to fulfill a need. These can come from Project Managers, the Proposal Group, Clinical Trial Managers, among others. The Second area is from Line Managers who have the resources to fulfill those requests. Communication with Line Managers about their Weekly Allocation uploads as required when errors or issues develop during the process.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • [20%] Manage the Resource Management Mailbox that is the centralized conduit for Resource Requests within CDCS. The purpose of this task is to read, interpret, and ensure appropriate emails are routed to the people who can fulfill the requests.
  • [20%] Manage and execute the weekly Allocation Upload Process. By close of business on Friday, 50-75 Excel Spreadsheets need to be uploaded into the Resource Management Tool via a Macro Tool developed by Resource Management.
  • [30%] Publishing of weekly reports from the Resource Management Tool. Each Week excel files are published to SharePoint from the Resource Management tool. Those Spreadsheets are generated via a Macro and do require mild manipulation prior to being published.
  • [20%] Base Line Resource Request (BRP) Loading into the Resource Management Tool. As work is awarded, an excel file from the Proposal/Contracting group is generated and needs to be loaded into the Resource Management Tool to populate the new Demand. Some Excel manipulation is required to ensure the proper format for an Excel Macro to run and perform the load.
  • [10%] Requires an understanding of the process and tools and has the ability to influence some change and enhancements to the process. Partnering with Manager develop different ways to streamline efficiencies and continuous improvement of process and tools.
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

  • University / college agree, or certification in related healthcare or resource management profession from an appropriately accredited institution
  • In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with four (5) or more years of relevant clinical research or resource management experience in pharmaceutical or CRO industry may be considered
  • Good understanding of the clinical trial process

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Minimum of three (5) years of professional experience.
  • In lieu of above requirement, candidates with four (4) years of clinical research (pharmaceutical research or contract research organizations) may be considered.
  • Strong ability to work within a project team.
  • Strong planning, organization, and problem-solving ability.
  • Strong oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and effective time management.
  • Ability to work with all levels of personnel.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Overtime and weekend work as required
  • Standard Office environment

Esta é uma oportunidade baseada em projetos em uma plataforma de treinamento de IA. Sem horário fixo, sem compromisso além do que se encaixa na sua rotina. Gravou, ganhou.

Sobre a Função

Estamos procurando pessoas para gravar vídeos em primeira pessoa de atividades domésticas do dia a dia. Você fixa o smartphone na cabeça, segue sua rotina normalmente, e a câmera captura exatamente o que você vê. Esses vídeos ajudam a treinar sistemas de IA e robôs a entender como as pessoas interagem com objetos em ambientes reais. Você lava louça todos os dias? Passa o aspirador no tapete? Passeia com o cachorro? Dobra roupa? E se você pudesse ganhar dinheiro apenas gravando isso?

Responsabilidades

  • Gravar atividades domésticas do dia a dia em primeira pessoa — cozinhar, limpar, organizar, dobrar roupa, cuidar do jardim, passear com o cachorro, entre outras
  • Gravar em sua própria casa, quintal, garagem ou espaço de trabalho
  • Seguir orientações breves de gravação para cada sessão
  • Enviar os vídeos pelo aplicativo do projeto

Requisitos

  • Equipamento: Ter ou utilizar um smartphone ou outro dispositivo de câmera capaz de gravar a 30 FPS ou mais e resolução de 1080p ou superior. iPhone 12 ou mais recente, Google Pixel 6+ ou Samsung Galaxy S21+ (deve ter lente grande angular / 0.5x)
  • Método de captura: Fixar o dispositivo na altura da testa ou dos olhos para obter uma perspectiva egocêntrica, mantendo um ângulo levemente inclinado para baixo para maximizar a visibilidade das mãos
  • Software: Utilizar o aplicativo designado "D&A" para toda a captura e envio de dados
  • Controle de qualidade: Garantir que todas as filmagens estejam nítidas, estáveis, bem iluminadas, com pelo menos 15 segundos de duração, e que retratem tarefas úteis e intencionais, sem pausas desnecessárias ou movimentos forçados

Por que essa oportunidade freelance é perfeita para você?

• Ganhe dinheiro enquanto faz suas tarefas domésticas: até o equivalente a $6 por hora, dependendo do projeto

• Este é um trabalho freelance baseado em projetos — escolha as sessões de gravação de acordo com sua disponibilidade

• Influencie o futuro de como a IA e os robôs entendem e interagem com o mundo real

Director of Outsourced Managed Services

Financial Aid Services (FAS)

About Us

At Financial Aid Services (FAS), we’re more than a consulting firm — we’re the trusted partner for colleges and universities navigating the complexities of financial aid. Our expert consultants help institutions strengthen their operations, optimize technology, maintain compliance, and fill critical leadership roles.

Our work is dynamic, impactful, and fast-paced — no two days are the same. Projects range from short-term assignments to year-long engagements, requiring strategic resource planning to match the right expertise with each institution’s needs.

The Opportunity to Make an Impact Beyond a Single Institution

FAS is seeking an experienced financial aid and higher education business leader to oversee and grow our Outsourced Managed Services division. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who have served as Directors, Executive Directors, Associate Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, or other senior leaders within financial aid and are interested in applying their expertise across multiple colleges and universities nationwide.

As Director of Outsourced Managed Services, you will lead a current team of 14 professionals supporting more than 20 active client engagements with the goal of expanding to 50+ clients in the next 24 months. You will work closely with FAS executive leadership to strengthen operational performance, ensure regulatory compliance, improve organizational effectiveness, and leverage technology, automation, and AI to modernize our processing operations.

This leader will play a critical role in transforming the financial aid operations of our clients into a strategic driver of enrollment growth and financial health. You will be responsible for re-engineering workflows, accelerating file turnaround times, standardizing service delivery, and driving innovation through AI-enabled solutions. The successful candidate brings deep financial aid expertise, strong operational leadership skills, a passion for client success, and the ability to build trusted partnerships with clients and internal teams.

What You'll Do

Operational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of 14 staff currently, including four Project Leads, providing vision, coaching, mentorship, and a high performance culture of accountability.
  • Manage processing operations across 20 active client engagements with the expectation of growing and scaling the operation to serve 50+ clients in the next 24 months.
  • Monitor project timelines, deliverables, quality standards, and client satisfaction metrics.
  • Identify and proactively address operational risks, resource constraints, and delivery challenges.
  • Optimize consultant utilization and minimize bench time while maintaining exceptional service quality.
  • Review and determine staffing allocations.
  • Develop a flexible workforce strategy that balances full-time employees and independent contractors to optimize utilization, control costs, and support business growth.
  • Monitor progress of all active processing engagements to ensure project milestones, deliverable deadlines, and quality standards are consistently achieved.
  • Re-engineer processing operations for speed, scalability, and consistency while maintaining strong compliance controls.
  • Establish performance targets and operational workflows designed to reduce file turnaround times and improve responsiveness to client needs.
  • Own and continuously evolve the Analyst Training and Performance Enablement program, including onboarding, skills development, knowledge management, coaching, performance improvement plans, and career progression pathways to build a scalable, high-performing workforce.

Process Excellence & Standardization

  • Document, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all processing services.
  • Standardize service delivery methodologies for key functional areas including to ensure consistency and quality across all client engagements:
    • Verification
    • Packaging and Awarding
    • Return of Title IV Funds (R2T4)
    • Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP)
    • Reconciliation
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase productivity, throughput, and overall operational effectiveness.

Performance Management & Reporting

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) within the FASTrax 2.0 platform, including:
    • Utilization
    • Productivity
    • Cycle times
    • Turnaround times
    • Quality assurance
  • Deliver data-driven operational insights and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Work with finance team to monitor engagement profitability, staffing efficiency, and resource utilization trends.
  • Maintain operational dashboards to support performance management and decision-making in FASTrax 2.0.

Innovation & Technology

  • Lead the transformation of the Processing Services division through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Identify workflow automation opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase operational capacity.
  • Leverage AI to streamline processing activities, accelerate decision-making, and improve service delivery.
  • Evaluate and standardize workflows to eliminate inefficiencies and create faster, more consistent outcomes for clients.
  • Drive initiatives to accelerate file turnaround times while maintaining high levels of quality and compliance.
  • Champion innovation and a culture of continuous improvement across the Processing Services division.

Client Partnership & Service Delivery

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for client concerns and operational issues.
  • Partner with institutions to ensure successful delivery of contracted services.
  • Collaborate with project teams to meet client expectations and ensure high-quality outcomes.
  • Understand long-term client goals and how our services need to adapt to meet those future client challenges and opportunities.
  • Foster long-term client relationships built on trust, responsiveness, and measurable results.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Maintain deep knowledge of federal financial aid regulations and industry best practices.
  • Support internal quality control reviews and annual audit initiative.
  • Monitor compliance trends and recommend enhancements to mitigate institutional and operational risk.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, accuracy, and regulatory excellence.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive financial aid leadership experience.
  • Experience leading financial aid operations at a college, university, system office, or higher education organization.
  • Demonstrated success managing teams, workflows, complex operational initiatives that include change management.
  • Deep understanding of Title IV regulations and financial aid administration.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and change management skills.
  • Demonstrated success leveraging technology to drive efficiency gains and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to lead high-performing teams in a remote environment.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and client management skills.
  • Experience using operational data and metrics to drive performance improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

Senior Accounting Manager – Multi-Entity Accounting & Financial Reporting

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a rapidly growing U.S. plumbing and home services company — is hiring a Senior Accounting Manager to own month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, and accounting controls across multiple entities.

The company is scaling from $20M+ toward $50M+ in annual revenue, making this a high-impact role focused on building accurate, scalable, and private equity-ready accounting processes.

Reporting to the VP of Accounting, you’ll have significant ownership and a clear growth path toward Corporate Accounting Manager.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own the full month-end close across multiple entities and locations
  • Prepare accurate financial statements and supporting schedules
  • Manage P&L reporting by business unit
  • Investigate variances and unusual financial trends
  • Maintain reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP

General Ledger & Reconciliations

  • Perform and review bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts and supporting schedules
  • Complete balance sheet tie-outs
  • Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies quickly

AR & Payroll Analysis

  • Oversee accounts receivable and outstanding balances
  • Review weekly multi-location payroll reports
  • Analyze payroll, labor costs, trends, and discrepancies
  • Support accurate financial planning and reporting

Audit, Controls & Process Improvement

  • Support internal and external audits across revenue, AR, inventory, fixed assets, AP, debt, equity, and payroll
  • Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation
  • Evaluate and test internal controls
  • Identify financial risks and potential misstatements
  • Build stronger, more scalable accounting processes as the company grows

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Proven ownership of the full month-end close
  • Strong multi-entity or multi-location accounting experience
  • Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports
  • Strong general ledger and balance sheet reconciliation experience
  • Experience reviewing accounts receivable and payroll
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and English communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • CPA or equivalent accounting qualification
  • Public accounting or external audit experience
  • Internal controls and audit testing experience
  • Private equity-backed or high-growth company experience
  • Construction, plumbing, HVAC, home services, or field-service industry experience

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely month-end closes
  • Reliable financial statements across all entities
  • Clean balance sheet and GL reconciliations
  • Strong audit readiness and internal controls
  • Accurate AR and payroll reporting
  • Fewer accounting discrepancies and reporting issues
  • Scalable processes that support continued company growth

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over a growing multi-entity accounting function
  • Direct exposure to the VP of Accounting and company leadership
  • Help build a PE-ready accounting infrastructure
  • Join a business scaling toward $50M+ revenue
  • Clear growth path into a Corporate Accounting Manager role
  • Fully remote opportunity

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Qualified candidates will receive a Spark Hire invitation to complete a short Intro Video. This gives the hiring team an opportunity to learn more about your accounting experience, communication style, and background with month-end close and multi-entity financial reporting.

Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’ve personally owned month-end close, have strong QuickBooks Online and U.S. GAAP experience, and enjoy building accurate, scalable accounting processes, we’d love to hear from you.

Work with us
Our team are passionate in the pursuit of excellence and in pushing the boundaries of cancer therapy and Autoimmune disease to deliver life-changing treatments to patients.

Whilst working at Autolus you will enjoy a flexible, diverse and dynamic working environment which actively promotes creativity, leadership and teamwork – together we are ONE Autolus.

Job Description:

Job Title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL)

Reports to: Regional Director, Field Medical

Department: Medical Affairs

Hours: Full Time – 40 hours

Location: US – Remote

About Autolus

Autolus is a biopharmaceutical company, advancing innovative therapies at both clinical and commercial stages of development, focused on next-generation, programmed T cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. Using a broad suite of proprietary and modular T cell programming technologies, the company is engineering precisely targeted, controlled, and highly active T cell therapies designed to better recognize cancer cells, break down their defence mechanisms, and eliminate these cells. Autolus has a pipeline of product candidates in development for the treatment of haematological malignancies, solid tumours, and autoimmune diseases.

Why Autolus

Our team is passionate in the pursuit of excellence and in pushing the boundaries of cancer therapy and autoimmune diseases to deliver life-changing treatments to patients. Whilst working at Autolus you will enjoy a flexible, diverse, and dynamic working environment which actively promotes creativity, leadership and teamwork. In addition to this Autolus is proud to offer a competitive salary, performance related bonus as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Our Promise

Autolus is developing complex, breakthrough therapies for a globally diverse market and equally recognises that diversity amongst our people is critical to our mission. As we draw on our differences, what we’ve experienced, and how we work, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Role Summary

The MSL is responsible for scientifically engaging, collaborating and aligning with a broad range of external stakeholders to address identified patient needs and ultimately improve the practice of medicine for better patient access and outcomes.

MSLs leverage the right evidence at the right time during their scientific engagements and identify medical intelligence and opportunities that impact and inform medical scientific communication and collaboration, science data generation plans, launch excellence roadmap, patient journey and medical strategy.

MSLs also contribute to innovative partnerships and implement relevant disease area strategies. They act as a strategic scientific partner, and collaborate with other field colleagues (e.g., commercial, market access, HEOR, clinical research colleagues) supporting healthcare systems in order to strengthen and improve patient access and outcomes.

MSLs have a highly developed expertise in the role and therapeutic area and expect to undertake an enhanced level of responsibility.

The ideal candidate will be based in either of these regions WA, OR, Northern CA (San Francisco), or CO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Through scientific exchange establish, develop, maintain, and personalise long term professional partnerships with a broad range of external stakeholders including, but not limited to, healthcare professionals, medical experts, investigators, researchers, pharmacists, payers, opinion leaders in key hospitals, institutions, and organizations.
  • Communicate the right evidence to the right stakeholder at the right time in scientifically appropriate fashion, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.
  • Partnering with health systems and identifying external medical intelligence, data gaps, data generation opportunities (including RWE and implementation science, precision medicine, research collaborations), and key unmet needs and opportunities to help improve patient access and outcomes.
  • In collaboration with clinical research colleagues, support clinical trial process, including, but not limited to, research site recommendations, assistance in managing Investigator relationships, providing medical expertise when required.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for information from stakeholders by sharing appropriate data regarding marketed and pipeline compounds in a timely, compliant, and stakeholder-focused manner.
  • Identify and share external medical intelligence, data gaps, data generation opportunities (including RWE and implementation science, precision medicine), and key un-met needs and opportunities to help improve patient access and outcomes.
  • Ensure appropriate identification and mapping of external stakeholders, aligned to the medical strategy, and in collaboration with other colleagues. Able to create personalised, flexible engagement strategies and plans, leveraging multiple channels and tailored content to meet the changing needs of external stakeholders.
  • Adopt and leverage digital channels for a broader, effective, personalised reach and impact, in addition to leading high level impactful scientific events, exchanges and medical education.
  • Apply foundational impactful scientific engagement principles in stakeholder interactions in alignment with medical strategy and portfolio/pipeline prioritisation.
  • Be a strategic internal partner, gather and leverage medical intelligence for an impactful contribution to Patient Journey mapping, launch excellence roadmap, integrated evidence generation plans, integrated product strategy and subsequently the medical strategy.
  • Utilise knowledge of assigned therapeutic area and compounds to serve as the medical, clinical, and scientific expert to field colleagues.
  • Typical activities of an MSL may include, but are not limited to, providing mentoring, guidance and formal field-training to Autolus colleagues, leading high level projects, executing special projects for the MSL Team Leader and representing the at Regional and Global meetings.
  • Manage personal and professional development.
  • Manage administrative responsibilities in a timely manner (customer relationship management tool, compliance training and other modules, expense reporting, etc.).
  • Promote and adhere to all company Ethics and Compliance Policies, and company guidelines for External Engagement.
  • Ability to travel 50% of the time, occasionally with short notice
  • KPIs
    • Time on field-related activities
    • Implementation of activities identified in plans
    • Quality of medical Intelligence gathered from external stakeholders
    • Management of processes and systems associated with field medical excellence

Demonstrated skills and competencies

E – Essential

P – Preferred

Experience

  • Five years of MSL, or relevant industry, experience with CAR T launch experience and extensive knowledge of hematologic malignancies.
  • Solid business mentality including leadership skills; innovative, solution-oriented, and critical thinking with performance-focused drive to achieve objectives and execute tactics.
  • Proven history of process improvement and team building.
  • Experienced in attaining customer insights and driving change in day-to-day operations.
  • Ability to operate in an environment with little direction and produce exceptional results.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across different channels to a variety of audiences.
  • Acts with credibility and clarity of purpose to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships.
  • Application of a curious mindset, employing active listening skills and asking open questions to gain medical intelligence and uncover current thinking.
  • Capable of self-directed learning and having a growth mindset.
  • Capable to adapt, organise, prioritise, and work effectively and collaboratively in multifunctional teams in a dynamic field-based environment.
  • Strong personal integrity reflected in all actions and behaviours.

Qualifications

  • Allopathic or Osteopathic Medical degree. Pharm.D., PhD, Doctor of Nursing Practice, or an APP (MSN/Nurse Practitioner or MS/Physician Assistant, other Terminal degree in health/life sciences (preferred). Bachelors of Science in Nursing with a minimum of 5 years experience in patient care and/or clinical research focused on hematologic malignancies, combined with 5 years of relevant industry experience focused on CART therapies. (acceptable)

Skills/Specialist knowledge

  • Proven ability to successfully leverage new technology/digital/IT solutions for effective stakeholder mapping, development, management, and field medical intelligence gathering.
  • Deep knowledge of CAR-T therapy.
  • Good awareness of research procedures and guidelines relevant to the pharmaceutical industry.
  • High-level of critical thinking and problem-solving acumen.
  • Process mapping and analytical problem solving leading to improved outcomes.
  • Proficient in communicating plans/progress to different audiences (manager, director, V.P., GM, etc).
  • Proficient in PowerPoint, excel, word, and a variety of project management software.
  • Direct approach to solving problems with a level of ingenuity reflective of a small pharmaceutical company.
  • Resilient under high-pressure environments especially during the immediate months following launch.
  • Ability to demonstrate matrix management & leadership behaviours with project teams:
    • Set clear and compelling goals that show project team how their work contributes to our purpose and strategy.
    • Creating joint plans with your project team to deliver your goals, holding yourself and others accountable for delivering quality results.
    • Cultivating a network of relationships across the organisation and building high performing teams based on mutual trust and respect.
    • Acting as a role model ensuring everything you do is in line with our values of respect, integrity, focus and breakthrough.

Autolus Core Competencies

Focus on Results: Works to meet business goals set by management and leaders

Builds Trust and Relationships: Ensures trust with internal and external partners by delivering on commitments

Resilience: Has the capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness

Communicates and Collaborates: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet objectives

If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

By leveraging state-of-the-art Quote-to-Cash technologies within Salesforce, the Agentforce Revenue Management Developer will help optimize sales and finance alignment, streamline operational processes, and deliver scalable, impactful solutions.

Our team is committed to building a best-in-class organization. As a Consultant, you will be responsible for the success of solution designs, providing technical leadership, and delivering transformational and financially impactful client solutions.

  • Design and implement custom code solutions which leverage Apex, Javascript, Visualforce, Lightning Components, Omniscript, and Business Rules Engine

Technical Skills

  • Development Skills: Familiarity with Apex and Omniscript
  • Data Analytics: Expertise in Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and sales performance analytics
  • Integration Tools: Knowledge of integration concepts and tools like MuleSoft, Workato, and REST/SOAP APIs

Additional Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for a variety of audiences and situations
  • Confident, self-assured, team-player, ambitious and driven
  • Detail and quality oriented with the desire and ability to rapidly learn and implement new concepts, business models, and technologies

  • Javascript, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce
  • Experience integrating Web Services (Scribe, SOAP, REST, JSON)

  • Strong experience using APEX on previous projects; Abilities to review / share feedback on Salesforce coding best practices supporting application scalability
  • Experience with an array of design patterns)

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. raw.description:
Descrição da vaga

O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil. Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor. Somos uma rede de talentos que impulsiona resultados exponenciais com responsabilidade, cuidado e espírito de colaboração.

Acreditamos que a beleza pode e deve inspirar mudanças.

Construa o futuro da beleza com a gente. Vamos juntos?

O que é o nosso time de Venda Direta?

No time de Venda Direta temos a missão de trazer beleza para a vida das nossas representantes. Entendemos a venda direta também como forma de empoderar quem sonha em empreender, e por isso queremos a melhor experiência possível para as pessoas empreendedoras. Em um mundo cada vez mais digital, transformar esse canal pela tecnologia é como construímos um ecossistema de beleza.

O produto em que você vai atuar:

No Grupo Boticário, Inteligência Artificial Generativa é pilar estratégico. Você irá atuar no time de Plataforma de Agentes: plataforma centralizada para criar, gerir e executar agentes LLM nos canais de negócio do GB. Sua missão será criar uma plataforma de construção de agentes para dar autonomia ao uso de Gen AI em times funcionais. Nosso foco é garantir que chegue até os diversos clientes do Grupo Boticário as melhores soluções envolvendo IA, alavancando resultados tangíveis para a empresa.

Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Manager I (coordenadora), com perfil empreendedor e alta capacidade de adaptação, para liderar o time de engenharia de Plataforma de Agentes.

Como será o seu dia

  • Gestão das pessoas do time de desenvolvimento de software, com o intuito de acompanhar e desenvolver nossos colaboradores (PDI), realizando sessões de 1:1, estabelecendo planos de ação e dando feedbacks de forma frequente;
  • Orientar as pessoas de sua equipe na utilização de práticas ágeis, facilitando cerimônias que façam parte da metodologia adotada pelo squad, como plannings, refinamentos, retrospectivas, etc.;
  • Remover impedimentos do time;
  • Promover um ambiente de respeito e confiança em conjunto com os membros do time, adaptando o seu estilo de liderança a diferentes situações;
  • Navegar pela companhia, identificando oportunidades e papéis-chave para o sucesso do time;
  • Coordenar iniciativas em que um ou mais times são necessários para o sucesso do produto;
  • Realizar sessões com todos os tipos de stakeholders para mostrar os últimos resultados alcançados, colher feedbacks/insights e realizar alinhamentos sobre o roadmap do produto;
  • Capacidade/habilidade de apresentar informações técnicas complexas de maneira clara e concisa para todos os tipos de stakeholders;
  • Construir a visão e missão do squad em conjunto com os membros do time;
  • Acompanhar frequentemente métricas de produto, métricas de negócio e indicadores técnicos, criticando, aprimorando e dando visibilidade dos objetivos e status de iniciativas do time;
  • Participar de processos de discovery de produto, mapeamento de problemas e soluções de incidentes;
  • Contribuir com a definição dos objetivos e métricas-chaves do produto/squad, expondo frequentemente esses resultados aos stakeholders (OKRs);
  • Estabelecer um processo de construção de software e a manutenção de um ritmo constante e saudável;
  • Lidar com necessidades/prioridades concorrentes, assumindo responsabilidades e riscos em um contexto cujo ritmo é acelerado e em constante mudança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência anterior em liderança de times de desenvolvimento de software para produtos digitais;
  • Background técnico forte (ex-desenvolvedor ou arquiteto) com capacidade para discutir arquitetura de software, integrações e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Vivência em melhoria de processos, produtos ou serviços.
  • Facilitação e resolução de problemas; times ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou equivalente).
  • Liderança em modernização ou migração de tecnologia e/ou processo.

Diferencial

  • Compreensão de como LLMs e agentes operam em produção. Frameworks do tipo Agno, LangChain ou equivalentes como referência (para gestão técnica, não necessariamente hands-on);
  • Ter liderado time multidisciplinar senior (engenharia de software, ciência de dados, MLE e AI).

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

*This role will be remote and cover CO, NV, AZ, and Southern CA.

Who You’ll Work With

When you join Arista’s VeloCloud Systems Engineering team, you become part of a team of industry experts who pioneered cloud-delivered SD-WAN. Reporting to the Systems Engineering Manager, you’ll work alongside skilled SD-WAN and networking engineers. Our team understands VeloCloud technologies, their integration with Arista portfolios, and their business impact, aligning solutions with the larger goals of our enterprise and service provider customers.

In collaboration with Engineering, Product Management, and leveraging Arista’s world-class TAC and Professional Services, you will play a pivotal role in selling, positioning, and designing solutions that incorporate VeloCloud technology to address customer challenges and support their technology and business transition in the era of AI.

What You’ll Do

We have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated individual to partner with our Account teams to provide technical systems engineering support for enterprise customers and channel partners.

The Senior Systems Engineer is a critical member of the Arista Customer Engineering team, acting as a trusted advisor for customers and channel partners to identify SD-WAN opportunities, gather WAN requirements, and design a solution that meets customers technical and business objectives.

  • Provide advanced support to the sales organization to drive successful sales of VeloCloud SD-WAN and campus solutions through channel partners and directly to end-customers

  • Deliver presentation, demonstration, and participate in sales call and conversation with prospects and customers

  • Architect and design VeloCloud SD-WAN network and overall Arista solutions, providing technical recommendations and advice to prospects, customers, and channel partners. This includes creating network designs utilizing VeloCloud’s cloud-delivered architecture, Dynamic Multipath Optimization, and integrated security capabilities

  • Architect and position the Arista SD-Branch architecture, delivering a full-stack network and security portfolio targeted for branch deployments.

  • Design integrated solutions that span SD-WAN, campus switching, wireless, and security, ensuring validated Zero Trust Networking and a holistic branch-level topology.

  • Lead the technical responses to RFIs, RFPs, and sales proposals

  • Translate complex customer WAN requirements into comprehensive VeloCloud and Arista network solutions consisting of design documents, statements of work, bills of materials, and support arrangements.

  • Perform Proof of Concept (PoC) including hands-on tests to validate customer POC setups

  • Provide technical training to VeloCloud prospects, customers, and channel partners, ensuring they are appropriately trained and prepared to successfully prospect, market, and sell VeloCloud solutions.

  • Handle customer escalation by partnering with engineering and our technical support team to ensure customers’ issues are resolved in a timely manner with the least impact to their business

  • Provide feedback to Engineering and Product Management on revenue-enhancing features and upgrades based on customer and partner feedback.

  • Represent Arista at customer and industry events, conferences, and channel partner presentations.

  • BS/CS/CE technical degree or relevant experience required.

  • Minimum of 7+ years of pre-sales experience with data centers, campus, WAN technologies, or Cloud services, particularly through Value Added Resellers and Systems Integrators for enterprise markets.

  • Technical Marketing Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Networking Engineer experience from companies in the WAN networking space, with hands-on experience managing POCs, field trials, and beta programs.

  • Experience supporting sales personnel on pre-sales calls, including presenting technical solutions, performing technical demonstrations, and providing technical context during the pre-sales cycle.

  • Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet/LAN switching, IPSec, IP Routing (OSPF, BGP), TCP/IP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, QoS, and SD-WAN technologies.

  • Knowledge of cloud services and familiarity of how to enable routing functionality in Virtual Private Cloud from AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Knowledge about automation including REST API, Python scripting, Ansible are a plus.

  • Exceptional communication and listening skills, ability to establish rapport and credibility with enterprise customers and channel partners.

  • Ability to effectively and energetically present technology and business propositions to customers, peers, and management.

  • Experience selling or supporting the broader Arista campus portfolio, including switches, WiFi, and security solutions.

  • Knowledge of Arista EOS and CloudVision for unified management and zero-touch operations.

  • Network Industry Certification is a plus

Compensation Information:

Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location to provide consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location. The pay range provided reflects base pay only; in addition, certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. Employees in Sales roles are eligible to participate in Arista’s Sales Incentive Plan, which pays commissions calculated as a percentage of eligible sales. US-based employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.

Compensation Information
Base pay range: $131- $170k flexible (depending on experience and location). Includes equity, bonuses, and comprehensive benefits. The actual salary offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and US location. The salary range provided reflects the base salary and in addition may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses, commissions, equity, and benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location

Arista Networks is an equal opportunity employer. Arista makes all hiring and employment-related decisions in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or any other factor determined to be unlawful under applicable federal, state, or law law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer with a unique blend of accounting experience who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

Compensation:

For this mid-level development role, with 3-7 years of experience, the compensation range is $2,800 - $6,000 USD per month. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

Sezzle Technical Stack:

  • Golang backend, React / React Native front-end
  • Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS
  • Gitlab CI/CD deployments
  • Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
  • Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Work as an integrated team member developing new features.
  • Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
  • Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
  • Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
  • Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

What We Look For:

  • Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
  • Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
  • Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with backend API development.
  • Experience with relational database storage and retrieval.
  • Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
